articleTitle: Blockchain-Based Secure and Searchable EHR Sharing Scheme
publicationTitle: 2019 4th International Conference on Mechanical, Control and Computer Engineering (ICMCCE)
abstract: Electronic Health Record (EHR) not only contains great value, but also implies a large amount of personal privacy. Aiming at the security problems such as data forgery and tampering in EHR data sharing process, this paper proposes a blockchain-based EHR data searchable scheme to realize the calculation and application of EHR data in the decentralized network environment. This paper stores the EHR data ciphertext on the cloud, and stores the keyword index of the EHR data on the blockchain. The data visitor's search result on the blockchain is only the blind value of the data identifier, and is generated after blinding. The token for downloading ciphertext data in the cloud not only improves storage efficiency of the system, but also ensures the integrity, immutability and traceability of the EHR data index. Based on the attribute encryption mechanism, the fine-grained access control of cloud data is realized, and the attribute signature technology is used to verify the authenticity of the EHR data source. Finally, experiments show that the encryption and search time of this scheme is constant, regardless of the number of attributes.

articleTitle: Research on Optimization of Static Gesture Recognition Based on Convolution Neural Network
publicationTitle: 2019 4th International Conference on Mechanical, Control and Computer Engineering (ICMCCE)
abstract: In order to solve the problems of low recognition rate and less recognition gesture categories caused by incomplete artificial feature extraction information in traditional static gesture recognition methods, a deep CNN framework is designed by using the principle of convolution neural network (Convolutional Neural Network, CNN) to recognize static gesture movements. Combined with a variety of optimal structures of convolution neural network in deep learning, a model with independent static gesture recognition function is realized. The model method can not only ensure the high accuracy and robustness of the recognition results, but also achieve the speed of smooth recognition.

articleTitle: Wind Turbine Blade Icing Prediction Based on Deep Belief Network
publicationTitle: 2019 4th International Conference on Mechanical, Control and Computer Engineering (ICMCCE)
abstract: Aiming at the problem that wind turbine blade icing poses a great threat to the power generation performance and safe operation of wind turbine, a blade icing prediction method based on deep belief network (DBN) is proposed in this paper. Firstly, the invalid data in the original data are removed, and preprocessing such as labeling, averaging and normalization is performed. The resampling method is used to solve the problem of uneven distribution of positive and negative samples. According to the relationship model between icing and wind turbine performance, the features of wind speed and power related to icing fault are selected. Secondly, a four-layer DBN network consisting of two RBMs and one classifier is established. After the model parameters are set, the features and labels of the training set are placed in the DBN for training. Get the optimal model after multiple iterations. Finally, the test set is predicted and evaluated. Compared with SVM algorithm, this method has high prediction accuracy and strong stability, and has a significant effect on improving the efficiency of deicing system and reducing the risk of wind turbine operation.

articleTitle: Underwater Acoustic Object Discrimination for Few-Shot Learning
publicationTitle: 2019 4th International Conference on Mechanical, Control and Computer Engineering (ICMCCE)
abstract: Deep neural networks are the go to algorithm when it comes to image classification [1-5]. This is partly because they can have arbitrarily large number of trainable parameters. However, this comes at a cost of requiring a large amount of data, which is sometimes not available. In the field of underwater acoustic object discrimination, data are scarce, no public dataset can be used for training, and data can only be collected by sea trials. In order to mitigate such an issue, we choose a few-shot learning with Siamese networks method. Siamese networks are a special type of neural network architecture. Instead of a model learning to classify its inputs, the neural networks learn to differentiate between two inputs. We trained our model to use only eighty single beam trajectories, divided into eight types of objects, and calculated the differences between each type of object, and the result show that our Few-shot Learning with Siamese networks can achieve good performance, we can achieve the target stable tracking on the multi-beam graph by the result of the difference between each type. This provides an important reference method for the application of deep learning in the field of underwater acoustic object recognition.

articleTitle: Identity-Based Aggregate Signature Scheme in Vehicle Ad-hoc Network
publicationTitle: 2019 4th International Conference on Mechanical, Control and Computer Engineering (ICMCCE)
abstract: Vehicle ad-hoc network (VANET) is the main driving force to alleviate traffic congestion and accelerate the construction of intelligent transportation. However, the rapid growth of the number of vehicles makes the construction of the safety system of the vehicle network facing multiple tests. This paper proposes an identity-based aggregate signature scheme to protect the privacy of vehicle identity, receive messages in time and authenticate quickly in VANET. The scheme uses aggregate signature algorithm to aggregate the signatures of multiple users into one signature, and joins the idea of batch authentication to complete the authentication of multiple vehicular units, thereby improving the verification efficiency. In addition, the pseudoidentity of vehicles is used to achieve the purpose of vehicle anonymity and privacy protection. Finally, the secure storage of message signatures is effectively realized by using reliable cloud storage technology. Compared with similar schemes, this paper improves authentication efficiency while ensuring security, and has lower storage overhead.

articleTitle: An Improved Scheme of Proof-of-Stake Consensus Mechanism
publicationTitle: 2019 4th International Conference on Mechanical, Control and Computer Engineering (ICMCCE)
abstract: Blockchain is a distributed system with decentralized, tamper-proof, traceability and other characteristics. The primary function of a distributed system is to enable consensus among nodes without trust. It is especially important to choose the appropriate consensus mechanism to improve the performance of the blockchain. Based on the original Proof of Stake (PoS), this paper introduces behavioral credits, establishes credit ratings, and interacts with the currency age in the PoS mechanism. By this way, it makes the revenue distribution of the nodes participating in the generation of the PoS mechanism more fair and reasonable, improves social stratification and resists the trend of system centralization.

articleTitle: Research on Coverless Text Steganography Based on Multi-rule Language Models Alternation
publicationTitle: 2019 4th International Conference on Mechanical, Control and Computer Engineering (ICMCCE)
abstract: Information hiding technology usually uses video, audio, image, and text as carriers. Among them, text redundancy is less and it is difficult to hide information. However, the text is widely used, so text-based information hiding has very important research significance. In this paper, a coverless text steganography based on multi-rule language models alternation is proposed. It is different from the traditional steganographic text generation method based on a single gram model. The method proposed in the paper tries to combine models under different language rules alternately, and tries to extract more language features from the training text. In order to verify the effectiveness of the method, we design some relevant experiments. The results show that, compared with other text steganography methods, the method proposed in the paper not only satisfies the concealment but also improves the hiding capacity.

articleTitle: Lightweight Searchable Encryption Scheme Based on Certificateless Cryptosystem
publicationTitle: 2019 4th International Conference on Mechanical, Control and Computer Engineering (ICMCCE)
abstract: Searchable encryption technology can guarantee the confidentiality of cloud data and the searchability of ciphertext data, which has a very broad application prospect in cloud storage environments. However, most existing searchable encryption schemes have problems, such as excessive computational overhead and low security. In order to solve these problems, a lightweight searchable encryption scheme based on certificateless cryptosystem is proposed. The user's final private key consists of partial private key and secret value, which effectively solves the certificate management problem of the traditional cryptosystem and the key escrow problem of identity-based cryptosystem. At the same time, the introduction of third-party manager has significantly reduced the burden in the cloud server and achieved lightweight multi-user ciphertext retrieval. In addition, the data owner stores the file index in the third-party manager, while the file ciphertext is stored in the cloud server. This ensures that the file index is not known by the cloud server. The analysis results show that the scheme satisfies trapdoor indistinguishability and can resist keyword guessing attacks. Compared with similar certificateless encryption schemes, it has higher computational performance in key generation, keyword encryption, trapdoor generation and keyword search.

articleTitle: Speed Control of Tracked Vehicle Autonomous Driving System using Fuzzy Self-Tuning PID
publicationTitle: 2019 4th International Conference on Mechanical, Control and Computer Engineering (ICMCCE)
abstract: A novel fuzzy self-tuning PID controller is proposed to solve non-linear, time-varying and response lagging problems in speed control of unmanned tracked vehicles. By adding a fuzzy controller on conventional PID method and a throttle brake logic switching rules with buffer structure, the controller can set PID parameters online to improve the stability and accuracy of speed control system and avoid frequent throttle brake switching. Simulation experiments prove the proposed method can reduce system overshoot and enhance the anti-interference ability of the system with a certain degree of robustness.

articleTitle: Case Study on Seat Management of University Library Based on WeChat Public Number Client—Taking Jianghan University Library as an Example
publicationTitle: 2019 4th International Conference on Mechanical, Control and Computer Engineering (ICMCCE)
abstract: University library is an important learning place for students, but it is always affected by seat occupancy problem. In order to solve the long-term occupancy problem of self-study space in the library, the library of Jianghan University introduced the WeChat Public Number Seat Reservation Management System, and achieved obvious results through its operation.

articleTitle: Coverless Text Steganography Based on Half Frequency Crossover Rule
publicationTitle: 2019 4th International Conference on Mechanical, Control and Computer Engineering (ICMCCE)
abstract: In the development process of the information hiding technology, text steganography is a challenging task for researchers because of the small redundancy of information and the difficulty in hiding information. In this paper, a coverless text steganography method is proposed based on the Markov model and the half frequency crossover rule, which accords with the statistical characteristics of natural language. In order to prove the effectiveness of the algorithm, we select two large scale datasets for modeling and testing. The experimental results show that, compared with similar methods, the proposed model shows better concealment and hidden capacity in steganography.

articleTitle: Comparative Study of BP Neural Network and RBF Neural Network in Surface Reconstruction
publicationTitle: 2019 4th International Conference on Mechanical, Control and Computer Engineering (ICMCCE)
abstract: Aiming at the surface reconstruction problem, the surface reconstruction methods based on BP and RBF neural networks are studied respectively, and the two neural network models are compared. The results show that both network models can effectively reconstruct the surface. The BP model has a short running time, but the randomness of the weights and thresholds make the model stable. The RBF model has high reconstruction stability, but the fitting time is longer than the BP model. Both have their own advantages. The specific application should be determined according to the specific research object.

articleTitle: Secret Sharing Scheme Based on Chinese Remainder Theorem in Cloud Computing
publicationTitle: 2019 4th International Conference on Mechanical, Control and Computer Engineering (ICMCCE)
abstract: For the problem of stealing user privacy data by non-trusted cloud computing service providers, the secret-sharing technique are applied to the cloud computing environment by using the Chinese remainder theorem, elliptic curve discrete logarithm problem and bilinear transformation. As a new verifiable secret sharing scheme, the Chinese residual theorem aims to allocate the special secret share and the common secret share respectively to the user and the cloud service provider. Without the participation of the user, the cloud service provider cannot restore the user's private data. The solution can detect the honesty of the cloud service provider and detect the fraud behavior of the cloud service provider in the system. The elliptic curve and the bilinear pairing technology. Not only reduces the computational cost of the system, but also achieves the verifiability of the solution and enhances the security of the system.

articleTitle: Simulation Optimization Under Random Conditions TG Business Model of Spare Parts Inventory
publicationTitle: 2019 4th International Conference on Mechanical, Control and Computer Engineering (ICMCCE)
abstract: Given the characteristics of spare parts storage in the TG rolling plant, the main spare parts are classified and managed by the combination of the two categories of inventory circulation speed and technical criticality. The key evaluation indicators of spare parts cost, spare parts maintenance, and inventory management are evaluated by AHP. Based on this, the inventory control model based on random demand and random lead time is established, and the economic order volume, order point, and safety inventory are obtained based on cost consideration so that the inventory cost can be controlled, and then the simulation verification based on ExtendSim software is established. Finally, a reasonable and effective inventory management control strategy for the TG enterprise rolling workshop spare parts inventory reference is provided.

articleTitle: Research on Economic Development Level of Western Provinces in China Based on Cluster Analysis
publicationTitle: 2019 4th International Conference on Mechanical, Control and Computer Engineering (ICMCCE)
abstract: After the reform and development, through decades of development, the economic situation of Western China has undergone tremendous changes. Especially since the implementation of the strategy of Western development, the economy of Western China has developed rapidly. Based on the economic data of the western provinces of China in 2018 in the China Statistical Yearbook, this paper chooses several indicators to establish a scientific and reasonable evaluation index, and classifies the western provinces according to their economic conditions by cluster analysis. It is found that 12 provinces in Western China can be divided into four categories, of which Sichuan is the first, Inner Mongolia, Chongqing and Shaanxi are the second, Yunnan, Guangxi, Guizhou and Xinjiang are the third, and Tibet, Qinghai, Ningxia and Gansu are the fourth.

articleTitle: Research on Wood Species Recognition Method Based on Hyperspectral Image Texture Features
publicationTitle: 2019 4th International Conference on Mechanical, Control and Computer Engineering (ICMCCE)
abstract: Hyperspectral imaging technology originated from remote sensing measurement, which combines two-dimensional imaging and spectral technology organically. It can obtain spatial and spectral information of the object of study at the same time. However, it has just begun to solve the problem of wood species recognition in China. In this paper, the hyperspectral data of wood species sample are obtained in the range of 400-2500 nm. PCA is used to reduce the dimension of the original hyperspectral image data, and the principal component image sequence is obtained. The wood texture feature parameters are extracted from the principal component image sequence. The recognition rate of PNN neural network classifier is 96.5%. Experiment shows that this method is suitable for solving the problem of wood species recognition.

articleTitle: Research on the Application and Security of Cloud Computing in Smart Power Grids
publicationTitle: 2019 4th International Conference on Mechanical, Control and Computer Engineering (ICMCCE)
abstract: With the advent of the reforms of the third era, people's lives have undergone tremendous changes, and the electric power development has also accelerated. The smart power grid is widely used, and based on its specific features, it has developed a cloud computing technology with more convenient, fast calculation methods and storage modes. This paper proposes specific cloud computing solutions to provide effective technical support for storage and computing of smart power grids. At the same time, we design a scheme for smart power grid cloud computing, and explains the various benefits with the cloud computing, and the existing security issues and preventive measures are also discussed.

articleTitle: Stock Recommendation Based on Depth BRNN and Bi-LSTM
publicationTitle: 2019 4th International Conference on Mechanical, Control and Computer Engineering (ICMCCE)
abstract: In the face of increasingly complex stock data information, the prediction model based on traditional statistical model is gradually unable to meet the needs of user personalization, accuracy and short time. A prediction model based on deep bidirectional cyclic neural network (BRNN) and bidirectional long and short term memory network (Bi-LSTM) was proposed to make the prediction data more reasonable for users to make decisions. This model introduces deep neural network and Dropout algorithm, which has strong anti-jamming ability and learning ability. It not only solves the problem of gradient disappearance and gradient explosion caused by long-term dependence of learning, but also optimizes the problem of overfitting and slow convergence caused by deep network model to some extent. The experiment on the NSE data set shows that this prediction model improves the determination coefficient by 5% and reduces the error by 3%-5% compared with the existing prediction model.

articleTitle: The Method of Embedded Device Firmware Update Under Multi-layer Heterogeneous Network
publicationTitle: 2019 4th International Conference on Mechanical, Control and Computer Engineering (ICMCCE)
abstract: In the coal mine, there are many network topologies and complex links. How to directly update the embedded device firmware from the ground control room, which is a difficult problem in engineering maintenance. Therefore, this paper proposes an open-end firmware update method for embedded devices that supports multiple layers and is not limited. The method mainly includes a bootloader, a probe program, and a device route description. A large number of tests show that the method is stable and reliable, and greatly reduces the workload of engineering maintenance.

articleTitle: Lane Change Control for Self-Driving Vehicle Based on Model Predictive Control Considering the Instability of Sensor Detection
publicationTitle: 2019 4th International Conference on Mechanical, Control and Computer Engineering (ICMCCE)
abstract: Lane change maneuver has great potential to cause serious traffic accidents, and the accurate detection of the surrounding environment is a decisive factor to decide whether the lane change process is safe. Therefore, this paper proposes a fusion method of radar arrays and vision sensor, and it takes possible obstacle miss and detection inaccuracy of sensors into consideration. Then, path planning and controller is designed based on 5th polynomial curve and model predictive controller. In order to test the effectiveness of the proposed algorithm, simulation experiments of lane change control are performed. Simulation results show that the proposed method can successfully support the process of lane change control.

articleTitle: A Survey of Low Resource Neural Machine Translation
publicationTitle: 2019 4th International Conference on Mechanical, Control and Computer Engineering (ICMCCE)
abstract: Machine translation is one of the important research directions in the field of artificial intelligence and natural language. It has important scientific research value and practical value. Neural machine translation (NMT) is a new machine translation model which uses neural network to realize the transformation from source language to target language. In recent years, neural machine translation method based on sequence to sequence has major breakthrough in machine translation task, in most of the language of the translation effect beyond the effects of statistical machine translation, but for the translation under the condition of scarce resources, neural machine translation has yet to achieve the desired effect, this paper mainly introduces several effective methods and models under low resource conditions, as well as their problems and challenges, and the existing problems and challenges. Then look forward to the future research direction and development trend.

articleTitle: Research on Speech Enhancement Algorithm Based on SA-Unet
publicationTitle: 2019 4th International Conference on Mechanical, Control and Computer Engineering (ICMCCE)
abstract: Most of the traditional speech enhancement algorithms are studied in the speech and audio domain. However, the suppression of noise by these methods is not obvious, and the effect of extracting pure speech is not good. In recent years, deep learning has been effectively developed based on its strong learning ability and is being used by more and more researchers. In view of this, this paper proposes a deep learning network model for research in the time domain, which is a SA-Unet network model that combines self-attention and Unet network structure and uses it for speech separation tasks. The model adds a self-attention mechanism between up-sampling and down-sampling in the Unet structure to enhance the perception between contexts, thereby more accurately separating the noise portion of the speech. Finally, the speech quality assessment scores are objectively obtained through the speech quality evaluation indicators and compared with the traditional speech enhancement algorithms. Experiments prove that SA-Unet has made outstanding contributions to speech enhancement technology.

articleTitle: Analysis of Autonomic Nervous System Based on HRV
publicationTitle: 2019 4th International Conference on Mechanical, Control and Computer Engineering (ICMCCE)
abstract: The autonomic nervous system is directly related to human mental load. In this paper, an autonomic nervous system analysis system based on ECG is designed for evaluating the state of psychological stress objectively. Firstly, the changes of ECG signals are obtained in real-time by using AD8232 modules. Then the signal processing and wireless transmission are carried out by using Bluetooth technology to the computer. Analysis of heart rate variability in ECG by upper computer is designed. Finally, the results of the ECG analysis are combined to realize the automatic evaluation of autonomic nervous system state. At the same time, the experiment of pressure induction and evaluation is designed for verifying specific groups and combined with the VAS test. The results show that the system can detect equilibrium of autonomic nervous system and psychological stress more objectively, comprehensively and accurately.

articleTitle: Remaining Useful Life Prediction for Equipment with Periodic Maintenance
publicationTitle: 2019 4th International Conference on Mechanical, Control and Computer Engineering (ICMCCE)
abstract: Remaining useful life (RUL) is a key procedure of prognostics health management (PHM), which is central to guarantee the safety of the equipment. In general, some maintenance activities will be implemented during the operation of an industrial equipment. Thus, to describe the degradation of an actual equipment, the effect of these maintenance activities must be considered. However, the current literature still falls short in degradation modeling and RUL prediction for equipment with maintenance. In this paper, we proposed a Brownian motion-based degradation model with periodic negative jump, to describe the degradation process of an equipment with periodic maintenance. We use maximum likelihood estimation (MLE) method to identify the unknown parameters in the model. And the Monte Carlo method is used to obtain the numerical probability density function (PDF) of the RUL with a given failure threshold. Finally, a numerical simulation is presented to illustrate the effectiveness of the proposed method.

articleTitle: A Task Parallel Processing Technology for Robot Process Automation
publicationTitle: 2019 4th International Conference on Mechanical, Control and Computer Engineering (ICMCCE)
abstract: RPA is often used as a substitute for people to perform repetitive office processes in a computer. The task of RPA is usually highly repetitive. At present, a single repetitive operation task can only be performed on a single robot, and there are problems such as low execution efficiency and waste of computing resources. The present invention proposes a method for a robot to perform tasks in parallel. The technology proposes a parallel robot design standard, and a task parallel robot, which realizes parallel execution of a single high repetitive RPA task without improving the design difficulty of the robot.

articleTitle: Research on the Sustainable Development Model of Information Technology Literacy of Normal Students Based on Deep Learning Recommendation System
publicationTitle: 2019 4th International Conference on Mechanical, Control and Computer Engineering (ICMCCE)
abstract: In recent years, deep learning has made breakthroughs in computer vision, speech recognition, natural language processing and recommendation systems. "Artificial Intelligence + Education" has been put on the agenda of our country. However, the level of information technology of primary and secondary school teachers in our country is still insufficient. There are many reasons for this problem. One of the important reasons that restrict the development of information technology ability of primary and secondary school teachers is the gap between the continuous learning of information technology and timely help of normal school students from learning to teaching, we propose to break this gap by using the model of recommendation system based on deep learning to improve the information technology ability of primary and secondary school teachers.

articleTitle: The Development Trend of Tibetan Decorative Art and Boudoir Architecture Integration and Cultural Tourism Under the Background of Big Data
publicationTitle: 2019 4th International Conference on Mechanical, Control and Computer Engineering (ICMCCE)
abstract: Tibetan art contains pious religious beliefs and unique culture and art, which has very high research value. As a branch of cultural literature and art, the combination of Tibetan decoration and boudoir architecture has opened up a new hot spot for the integration of cultural tourism. In particular, it is meaningful to analyze the development of cultural tourism in Tibet through the combing of big data. Based on Tibetan architectural art and combining with the big data analysis of the Internet era, this paper studies the decorative colors and forms of Tibetan architecture, and analyzes the artistic expressions and characteristics of Tibetan decoration. At the same time, combined with the regional characteristic buildings, the application of Tibetan decorative art in the boudoir building was deeply explored. A comprehensive analysis of its art form and color decoration effect can provide a reference for the current Tibetan architectural decoration.

articleTitle: Reliability Analysis of Solenoid Valve Power Supply Based on Time-Varying Fault Rate
publicationTitle: 2019 4th International Conference on Mechanical, Control and Computer Engineering (ICMCCE)
abstract: Analyzing the structure of the solenoid valve power system and the failure mechanism of the solenoid valve system, a sampling method of the duration of the solenoid valve power state based on the time-varying failure rate is proposed, which provides a reference for the reliability analysis and improved design of the power system. First of all, reliability indicators are established, such as system reliability and average power loss time. And the time-varying failure rate is used to accurately reflect the aging process of the power system. In order to reflect the influence of failure rate with time accurately, the calculation of availability rate is improved. Secondly, analyzing the failure mode of the solenoid valve power system and the failure mechanism of the solenoid valve system. Finally, based on the failure mechanism of the solenoid valve power system, the sequential Monte Carlo method is used to simulate the real operation, and the correlation analysis is carried out according to the obtained results. The analysis results show that the proposed method improves the accuracy of reliability analysis and provides reference for power system analysis and improvement.

articleTitle: Identity-Based Multi-replicas Data Public Audit Scheme
publicationTitle: 2019 4th International Conference on Mechanical, Control and Computer Engineering (ICMCCE)
abstract: When users outsource the data to the remote cloud servers, they lose physical control of data while gaining storage convenience and cannot ensure the integrity of cloud data. Therefore, a series of auditing schemes were proposed to solve the problem of cloud data integrity verification. However, the existing public auditing scheme mainly focuses on a single replica, and the dynamic update of data requires a large computational overhead. Aiming at these problems, a new identity-based multi-replicas public auditing scheme is proposed by using homomorphic authentication labels and multi-branch path tree. The analysis results show that the scheme can effectively audit the integrity of cloud data. Compared with similar schemes, it has higher computational efficiency.

articleTitle: A New Method of Fault Diagnosis in Rolling Bearings
publicationTitle: 2019 4th International Conference on Mechanical, Control and Computer Engineering (ICMCCE)
abstract: The rolling bearing plays a crucial role in industry and life, which is widely used in mechanical equipment. Its health will affect the safe operation of the equipment so monitoring the working state of bearings is necessary. The fault feature extraction method based on the combination of complete ensemble and empirical mode decomposition with adaptive noise (CEEMDAN) and fuzzy entropy is divided into three parts. Firstly, the collected vibration signal is decomposed into several intrinsic mode functions (IMF) by CEEMDAN. And then four relatively large modes are selected by using the correlation coefficient. Finally, fuzzy entropies are calculated separately and the results can be made to a fault feature. Support vector machines (SVM) is used to train diagnostic model. The experimental result shows that the method can improve the effect of feature extraction.

articleTitle: Research on the Application of 3D Virtual Simulation Technology in Ancient Village Restoration
publicationTitle: 2019 4th International Conference on Mechanical, Control and Computer Engineering (ICMCCE)
abstract: Ancient village as an important representative of Chinese traditional culture, not only show people the characteristics and charm of Chinese classical culture, also provided reference for people in the modern architectural design. In order to realize the restoration and visual reproduction of ancient village, this paper takes Guangzhou Conghua tower as an example, summarizes the process of digital restoration of ancient villages by using 3D virtual simulation technology, and using UE4 engine to make 3D roaming animation to display the features of ancient villages, which is of practical significance for the digital restoration and preservation of ancient villages.

articleTitle: Research on the Impact of China's Industrial Structure Change on Economic Growth and Fluctuation Based on Agricultural Development
publicationTitle: 2019 4th International Conference on Mechanical, Control and Computer Engineering (ICMCCE)
abstract: The process of rationalization and upgrading of industrial structure has a distinct stage effect on economic growth, and the relationship between rationalization of industrial structure and economic growth has a strong stability. On the contrary, the process of upgrading has the same impact mechanism on economic growth. The current economic development shows that the accumulation of capital is inevitably related to economic growth to a large extent, but from the perspective of the efficiency and efficiency of economic input, there is a significant correlation between the process of economic growth and the state of industrial structure. Relatively speaking, the relationship between industrial structure rationalization and economic growth has strong stability, while advancedization shows greater uncertainty. The impact of industrial structure rationalization and upgrading on economic fluctuations is mainly reflected in unpredictable cyclical fluctuations, and their impact mechanisms are quite different. Therefore, continuously optimize the industrial structure and enhance the ability of agricultural development to implement the sustainable development strategy, so as to realize the impact on the economic growth and fluctuations of the changes in China's industrial structure.

articleTitle: Erosion Mechanism and Simulation Analysis of Wind Turbine Blade Coating
publicationTitle: 2019 4th International Conference on Mechanical, Control and Computer Engineering (ICMCCE)
abstract: The wind turbine blade coating has an important protective effect on the blade base material of the wind turbine and improves the smoothness of the blade surface. But wind turbine blades are often eroded by wind sand in wind sand environment. For the study on the mechanism of sand particles impacting on the wind turbine blade coating, the model of sand particle impacting on the wind turbine blade coating has been built in ANSYS. The change of the equivalent stress on the surface of the coating and the shape appearance of the impact pit and the erosion rate of coating have been analyzed by sand particle with different particle sizes and different speeds impacting on the coating at different angles. The analysis results show that: when the sand particle impacts on the coating at the same velocity at different angles, the equivalent stress on the surface of the coating increases first and then decreases; when the smaller size sand particle impacts on the coating at lower wind speed, the equivalent stress on the surface of the coating is not more than the yield strength of the coating and only elastic deformation occurs on the surface of the coating; in the process of impact, different impact morphologies are formed on the surface of the coating due to different particle shapes; with the same impact angle and impact velocity, the erosion rate of the material increases linearly with the increase of the impact times. The results of this paper will provide some reference for reducing the erosion and wear of the blade coating and the design of the blade coating.

articleTitle: Construction and Application of Information-Based Teaching Resources Sharing Platform Based on Deep Learning
publicationTitle: 2019 4th International Conference on Mechanical, Control and Computer Engineering (ICMCCE)
abstract: Deep learning means that learners learn new content with critical thinking on the basis of understanding knowledge and integrate it into the original knowledge system to form in-depth insights. Deep learning emphasizes the autonomy, cooperation and exploration of learners' learning. To realize deep learning, learners need specialized and systematic learning resources. Based on the problems faced by the current information-based teaching and the concept of deep learning, this paper integrates resources of enterprises, society and schools, explores the construction of information-based teaching resource sharing platform based on deep learning, and provides learning support for independent inquiry learners. And also provides a reference to researchers engaged in information teaching in universities.

articleTitle: Intelligent Optimization Analysis of Target Tracking Based on Computer Vision
publicationTitle: 2019 4th International Conference on Mechanical, Control and Computer Engineering (ICMCCE)
abstract: In view of the problems exposed by particle filtering in solving computer vision target tracking, this paper introduces a solution combining ant colony algorithm and Mean Shift. On the one hand, with the help of the ant colony algorithm's spontaneous artificial intelligence search ability, the problem of particle depletion is improved, and the selection of the local optimal position of the target tracking is optimized during the target tracking observation model of particle filtering. On the other hand, the Mean Shift target tracking algorithm is introduced, and the gradient tracking function is used to optimize the target tracking accuracy; in the target state transition model of particle filtering, the global convergence response time of the target tracking is compressed. Simulation experiments show that the improved particle filtering method by ant colony algorithm +Mean Shift not only improves the timeliness and accuracy of target tracking, but also enhances the artificial intelligence attribute of target tracking.

articleTitle: Design of Frequency and Pattern Reconfigurable Wideband Semi-Circular Slot Ring Antenna
publicationTitle: 2019 4th International Conference on Mechanical, Control and Computer Engineering (ICMCCE)
abstract: In this paper, a printed and miniaturized planar slot antenna is designed, which has the function of pattern and frequency reconfigurability. The antenna structure consists of two semi-circular slots, a CPW open ended branch and a CPW feedline. By changing the states of switches, the antenna can operate among the three frequency reconfigurable states of low band, high band and dual band. The low and high band cover 2.23-3.49GHz and 5.43-5.94 GHz, respectively. The null direction of radiation pattern at high frequency band can also be steered by changing the states of the switches installed in the semi-circular slot. When the antenna operates in 5.8 GHz. The antenna does not have any additional matching circuit, which brings simple structure and wideband.

articleTitle: Research on Face Super Resolution Reconstruction Based on DBGAN
publicationTitle: 2019 4th International Conference on Mechanical, Control and Computer Engineering (ICMCCE)
abstract: Super-resolution reconstruction technology is an important research topic in many fields such as image processing and computer vision. This technology can be used widely for security monitoring, old image reconstruction, image compression transmission and other fields. In this paper, super-resolution image reconstruction is performed on a low-resolution image of four times magnification. We propose the dense convolutional networks used as a generator instead of residual networks, and set perceptual loss as the optimization goal. We use the VGG network feature map as the loss function instead of Mean Square Error, which combines the perceptual loss with the adversarial loss and is beneficial for compensating the shortcomings of previous methods that lack high frequency detail. Experimental results show that our method can produce clearer face images than the traditional methods. These reconstructed images have higher resolution and Peak Signal to Noise Ratio (PSNR) and Structural Similarity Index (SSIM) than the images generated by the deep residual networks.

articleTitle: Airport Taxi Decision-Making Strategy Based on Queuing Theory and Computer Simulation
publicationTitle: 2019 4th International Conference on Mechanical, Control and Computer Engineering (ICMCCE)
abstract: Taxi is one of the important connections between large transportation hubs and urban transportation. This paper addresses the decision-making strategy for airport taxi drivers in order to improve transportation efficiency. Firstly, the decision-making model of taxi drivers based on opportunity cost is established. This paper also takes Beijing Capital International Airport as an example to solve this model by combining the queuing theory and Monte Carlo method, and uses the Logit model to analyze the correlative factors. Then, the suggestion of setting up the taxi pick-up points is proposed to improve the efficiency of traffic flow. Finally, result of computer simulation further shows that when the entrance of the fast lane is about 11 parking spaces away from the taxi pick-up point, it can improve the efficiency of traffic flow and lead to a tripartite win-win situation: taxi drivers get higher revenue, passengers leave the airport in time and the managers to execute the airport more efficiently.

articleTitle: Study on Processing Process of SiC Single Crystal Cut with Wire Saw Excited by Ultrasonic
publicationTitle: 2019 4th International Conference on Mechanical, Control and Computer Engineering (ICMCCE)
abstract: Owing to high hardness and brittleness, SiC single crystal is the typical difficult-to-machine material. The SiC single crystal workpiece was cut by wire saw excited by transverse ultrasonic, and the cutting process was analyzed in current research. The kinematics equation of ultrasonic excitation wire saw and ordinary wire saw were established, and two different kinematics characteristics were analyzed respectively. The trajectory of abrasive particles in two cutting mode changed fundamentally. The finite element simulation model of single diamond abrasive cutting SiC single crystal was established. The influence of processing parameters on sawing force, surface morphology of SiC single crystal cut with abrasive excited by ultrasonic and ordinary diamond abrasive cutting was analyzed. The results show that sawing force of diamond abrasive excited by ultrasonic is much less than that of ordinary diamond abrasive cutting and the surface morphology is fairly flat. The cutting depth of abrasive has a significant influence on the sawing force and wafer surface.

articleTitle: A Multi-Strategy Combined Grey Wolf Optimization Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2019 4th International Conference on Mechanical, Control and Computer Engineering (ICMCCE)
abstract: The Grey Wolf Optimization (GWO) Algorithm is a heuristic evolutionary algorithm inspired by the hunting and leadership mechanisms of the natural grey wolf. However, its location update equation has the disadvantages of strong development ability and weak exploration ability. To improve these shortcomings, we propose the RWCA-GWO algorithm. It occurs inspired by the random walk strategy and enhances the exploration ability of the leading wolves. Inspired by the analytic hierarchy process, a procedure for setting the weights of α, β, and δ are proposed. Besides, to promote the global convergence speed of the GWO algorithm, the initial population is generated by the chaotic initialization method. The simulation experiments are carried out with 11 test functions. The results show that for most cases, the performance of RWCA-GWO algorithm is significantly better than the standard grey wolf algorithm and other improved grey wolf algorithms under the same maximum fitness function evaluation times.

articleTitle: Optimized Clustering Routing Algorithm Based on Deviation Maximization Method and the BFS
publicationTitle: 2019 4th International Conference on Mechanical, Control and Computer Engineering (ICMCCE)
abstract: Energy efficient routing algorithm is an important measure to balance energy consumption in wireless sensor networks. An optimized clustering routing algorithm based on deviation maximization method and the best priority search method BFS (ORADB) is proposed in this paper. Firstly, the distance from the nodes to the base station, the residual energy of the nodes and the density of the neighbor nodes are considered comprehensively, and adopt the deviation maximization method to objectively weight the influence factors, so as to realize the optimization of cluster head selection. Secondly, the BFS algorithm, which takes the link cost calculated by node energy consumption and the distance from node to base station as heuristic function is used to select the shortest multi-hop path between cluster heads with the lowest link cost to optimize the data transmission path. Finally, simulation experiments show that compared with LEACH and LEACH-C, the ORADB algorithm can optimize cluster heads selection and multi-hop transmission path between cluster heads. The number of surviving nodes decreases slowly, the total energy consumption of the network is more balanced, and the life cycle of the network is prolonged.

articleTitle: Research on Data Compression Algorithm of Heating Data Center Based on Adaptive Swinging Door Trending
publicationTitle: 2019 4th International Conference on Mechanical, Control and Computer Engineering (ICMCCE)
abstract: The 21st century is the century full of information. The data compression is an indispensable key technology in the information society. We use adaptive swinging door trending in the historical data compression of the heating data center. The experimental results show that the algorithm can compress the historical data faster, obtain a higher compression ratio, and ensure that the decompressed data has higher accuracy.

articleTitle: Fault Diagnosis for PWM Inverter Based on LMD
publicationTitle: 2019 4th International Conference on Mechanical, Control and Computer Engineering (ICMCCE)
abstract: Focusing on the character of nonlinear and the non-stationary characteristics of the fault signal of inverter, this paper proposes a method of open-circuit fault diagnosis for PWM inverter which based on local mean decomposition(LMD). the simulation model of inverter driving control system is built, getting three-phase output current of different fault conditions. LMD method is used to decompose three-phase output current respectively. the feature vector of fault is constructed with energy value of the principal component and proportional coefficient of the forward current in each phase. Finally, the model of fault diagnosis is constructed with neural network to locate the leg of bridge with open-circuit fault of the inverter. According to the simulation and experiment, the results show that the method by using local mean decomposition for fault signal are good, it provides a new approach of fault diagnosis for PWM inverter with open-circuit .

articleTitle: The Density-Based Descending Dimension Algorithm LLE
publicationTitle: 2019 4th International Conference on Mechanical, Control and Computer Engineering (ICMCCE)
abstract: When computer scientists expect to obtain valuable information through data mining in massive data, they are often confronted with the excessive feature of big data and complex high-dimensional structure. Therefore, researchers have introduced the concept of manifold learning to remove the redundant features which account for a large proportion but have no value, which can help improve learning efficiency by reducing computational complexity. In the actual process, however, there will always be discordant factors interfering with our judgment on the data. Therefore, this paper proposes a new, improved LLE dimension reduction algorithm based on data density judgment, which is simply referred to as DLLE. This algorithm is aimed to avoid the interference of noise points and the influence of surface boundary blur on dimension reduction caused by irregular manifold structure, thus better preserving the true geodesic distance of the data after the dimension reduction. An experiment is carried out on several sets of 3D synthetic datasets, whose results show that the improved algorithm is superior to the traditional LLE algorithm.

articleTitle: Data Fusion Optimization Analysis of Wireless Sensor Networks Based on Joint DS Evidence Theory and Matrix Analysis
publicationTitle: 2019 4th International Conference on Mechanical, Control and Computer Engineering (ICMCCE)
abstract: In view of the energy Limitation and data redundancy of wireless sensor networks (WSN), in order to better coordinate WSN computing resources and make rational use of its energy, this paper uses DS evidence theory and matrix analysis to jointly improve WSN consumption and efficient use of redundant data. On the one hand, the DS evidence theory is used to fuse redundant data of WSN; on the other hand, with the idea of matrix analysis, the process of DS evidence theory fusion is accelerated. Simulation experiments show that this joint mode not only improves the energy utilization of WSN, but also optimizes the transmission data quality of WSN.

articleTitle: Anti-Collision System Design of Vehicle Lane Change Overtaking
publicationTitle: 2019 4th International Conference on Mechanical, Control and Computer Engineering (ICMCCE)
abstract: Collision accidents occur frequently during the current car driving, most of which are caused by improper driver behavior and misjudgment. This paper proposes an anti-collision assisted driving system design for vehicle overtaking. The main function of the system is to remind the driver when to change the time of the lane change for safety, so as to achieve the anti-collision effect. Firstly, the lane changing process is analyzed. Then based on the research of the optimal path planning strategy for vehicle lane change, two variable path trajectory curve models of polynomial function and sinusoidal function are selected. Finally, the critical collision time point is derived and calculated in combination with the established model. After this time point, the lane change can ensure the safety of driving. The model is simulated and the "human-car-road" model is established by CarSim: driver control model, vehicle dynamics model and road scene model. And combined with MATLAB, the simulation is carried out from the longitudinal relative speed of the two vehicles and the horizontal relative distance between the two vehicles. The results show that the critical time calculated by the sinusoidal model is safer when the relative vehicle speed is lower, and the critical time calculated by the polynomial curve model is safer when the relative vehicle speed is higher. At the same time, the safety critical time points will decrease as the relative speed and the relative distance increase. The design of the assisted driving system proposed in this paper can effectively reduce the collision accident of the car and can lay a good foundation for intelligent driving.

articleTitle: Hardhat-Wearing Detection with Cloud-Edge Collaboration in Power Internet-of-Things
publicationTitle: 2019 4th International Conference on Mechanical, Control and Computer Engineering (ICMCCE)
abstract: Personal security of the workers is the most important issue in the electric construction site. Hardhat is a critical way to protect the security of construction workers on the site. However, some workers do not wear the hardhat at the work site due to lower security awareness. A hardhat-wearing detection scheme based on work site images adopting the Single Shot MultiBox Detector (SSD) is proposed to detect the no-hardhat-wearing at the electric site. This algorithm is introduced into the power internet-of-things by a cloud-edge collaboration mechanism. In this mechanism, the cloud center trains the detection mode with a large training image dataset. The trained model is issued to the intelligent camera. The camera at the edge site detects no-hardhat-wearing. This mechanism can make full use of the resource in the cloud center and improve the detection speed at the edge to eliminate the security risk in time. The detection results, instead of the original images, are only sent to the cloud center, which can reduce the transmission bandwidth of the power internet-of-things. The experimental results demonstrate that the proposed hardhat-wearing detection scheme with cloud-edge collaboration mechanism achieves a better detection precision.

articleTitle: Breast Cancer Pathological Image Auto-Classification using Weighted GLCM-SVM
publicationTitle: 2019 4th International Conference on Mechanical, Control and Computer Engineering (ICMCCE)
abstract: At present, when radiologists screen the breast cancer, they always miss about 10-30% tumors for pathological edge blurring and asthenopia after the diagnosis for a long time. For this reason, setting up the Computer Aided Diagnosis (CAD) system is of great clinical application value. This thesis proposes the method of weighted GLCM to extract the texture features of mammogram and classify abnormal regions according to the evaluation of the performance of each individual by using support vector machines (SVM). The experiment shows our system is effective for breast cancer pathological image.

articleTitle: Wind Turbine Kinetic Energy Accumulation and Release Regulation for Wind Farm Optimization
publicationTitle: 2019 4th International Conference on Mechanical, Control and Computer Engineering (ICMCCE)
abstract: Based on wind turbine rotation kinetic energy accumulation and release, wind farm optimization operation was introduced in this paper. The wind turbines in the wind farm have a certain kinetic energy storage capacity, which can be used to implement energy accumulation and release. This is beneficial to wind farm and electricity grid regulation. First, power conversion efficiency under middle and low wind speed can be improved by this method, which includes kinetic energy of wind turbine accumulation and release. This method transfers turbine kinetic energy from lower rotation speed to higher rotation speed to convert mechanical energy into electrical energy by generator, which has higher efficiency. Second, kinetic energy accumulation and release of wind turbine, can be used to regulate electricity grid fluctuation with quick response. In conclusion, utilization of wind turbine based kinetic energy accumulation and release, is a useful method to optimize the wind farm and electricity grid system.

articleTitle: Research on Automatic Detection Algorithm of Pulmonary Nodules Based on Deep Learning
publicationTitle: 2019 4th International Conference on Mechanical, Control and Computer Engineering (ICMCCE)
abstract: Deep learning can automatically extract multi-layer feature representations hidden between data, and has been successfully applied in the fields of speech recognition, image recognition and classification and segmentation and so on. In order to improve the detection rate of lung nodules during early lung cancer screening, this paper proposes a method which combined 2D and 3D Convolutional Neural Networks. Firstly, this paper proposes an end-to-end training method for joint generation prediction using convolutional neural networks and LSTM to conduct a preliminary test on the candidate nodules. Secondly, we construct a 3D convolutional neural network framework on the CT stereo image after the candidate nodule is generated and then we extract the 3D sample blocks in the candidate nodule to remove false positive ones. Finally, under different network parameters, we performed a group experiment on the CT images of 1018 patients in the LIDC database. Through continuous optimization of network parameters, the accuracy, sensitivity and specificity of the preliminary detection of nodules respectively reached 64.1%, 70.3%, and 60.7%. After the false positive removal, they reached: 83.4%, 86.5%, 80.3%. It proves that compared with the traditional method of detecting lung nodules, the performance of this method is improved, and the comprehensive performance is strong, which can provide effective help for lung cancer screening.

articleTitle: Real Time State Monitoring and Fault Diagnosis System for Motor Based on LabVIEW
publicationTitle: 2019 4th International Conference on Mechanical, Control and Computer Engineering (ICMCCE)
abstract: Motor is the most widely used production equipment in industrial field. In order to realize the real-time state monitoring and multi-fault pre-diagnosis of three-phase motor, this paper presents a design of three-phase motor state monitoring and fault diagnosis system based on LabVIEW. The multi-dimensional vibration acceleration, rotational speed, temperature, current and voltage signals of the motor are collected with NI cDAQ acquisition equipment in real time and high speed. At the same time, the health and fault state model of the motor is established. The order analysis algorithm is used to perform advanced analysis on the data, and the diagnosis and classification of different fault types are realized. The system is equipped with multi-channel acquisition, display, analysis and storage. Combined with the current cloud transmission technology, the system backs up the data to the cloud for further statistics analysis.

articleTitle: Research on Privacy Security Risk Evaluation of Intelligent Recommendation Mobile Applications Based on a Hierarchical Risk Factor Set
publicationTitle: 2019 4th International Conference on Mechanical, Control and Computer Engineering (ICMCCE)
abstract: Intelligent recommendation applications based on data mining have appeared as prospective solution for consumer's demand recognition in large-scale data, and it has contained a great deal of consumer data, which become the most valuable wealth of application providers. However, the increasing threat to consumer privacy security in intelligent recommendation mobile application (IR App) makes it necessary to have a risk evaluation to narrow the gap between consumers' need for convenience with efficiency and need for privacy security. For the previous risk evaluation researches mainly focus on the network security or information security for a single work, few of which consider the whole data lifecycle oriented privacy security risk evaluation, especially for IR App. In this paper, we analyze the IR App's features based on the survey on both algorithm research and market prospect, then provide a hierarchical factor set based privacy security risk evaluation method, which includes whole data lifecycle factors in different layers.

articleTitle: Research on Command and Control Network Load Redistribution Algorithm Based on "Triangle" Structure
publicationTitle: 2019 4th International Conference on Mechanical, Control and Computer Engineering (ICMCCE)
abstract: As an important channel of information transmission in the network, the key edge plays a vital role in the network information flow. In order to solve the problem of load redistribution of cascade failure network, this paper mainly does the following work. Firstly, When cascade failure occurs in the network, the process of cascading failure is analyzed according to the "triangle" position of the failed edge, thereby the load of the failed edge is allocated to the synergy edge or the skip-level edge according to the idle capacity. Secondly, a load redistribution method based on "triangle" structure is proposed. Finally, by randomly deleting edges, the carrying capacity of the network is simulated when the network is attacked. The experimental results show that the load redistribution algorithm proposed in this paper improves the destruction resistance of the command and control network.

articleTitle: Recommendation Algorithm Based on Explicit and Implicit Feedback Matrix Factorization
publicationTitle: 2019 4th International Conference on Mechanical, Control and Computer Engineering (ICMCCE)
abstract: Matrix factorization is an effective solution to sparse data problem in the recommendation algorithm, but it relies too much on the user's direct behavior, preventing the algorithm from representing the user's true preference for an item. In order to address this challenge, this paper establishes an implicit feedback model through the movie view duration based on explicit feedback. The alternating least-squares method and its optimization method ALS-WR are introduced to factorize the explicit feedback model and the implicit feedback model respectively into two user-latent factor matrices and two item-latent factor matrices. Then the concept of weight-value is introduced to integrate each pair of user-latent factor matrices and item-latent factor matrices to finally produce recommendations. The simulation experiment on the MovieLens dataset is compared with the ALS-based, ALS-WR-based, and SVD-based recommendation algorithms. The experiment results show that the algorithm proposed in the paper is superior to the above algorithms in terms of mean absolute error (MAE) and root mean square error (RMSE), and is effective in improving the quality of recommendation.

articleTitle: Design of Control System for Intelligent Beverage Machine Based on AT89C51
publicationTitle: 2019 4th International Conference on Mechanical, Control and Computer Engineering (ICMCCE)
abstract: An approach to the design of filling system of beverage machine based on AT89C51 microcontroller is explicitly elaborated in this paper. The filling system of beverage machine uses the way of quota of the liquid weight to actualize the liquid filling, and the design includes two parts, one is hardware circuit and the other is programs. This system performs stable. In addition, the cost of design and manufacture is lower, so it is easy to make promote and popularize widely.

articleTitle: Application of T-Beam Grillage Model in Reconstruction Design of Dangerous Bridge
publicationTitle: 2019 4th International Conference on Mechanical, Control and Computer Engineering (ICMCCE)
abstract: A hollow slab bridge located on a highway in Yunnan Province, China, was rated as the IV type of bridge in the evaluation and testing of its technical condition. After comparing the reinforcement and reconstruction schemes, it is decided to demolish and rebuild the bridge. The new bridge is designed as a 30m simply supported T-beam. The Grillage method of MIDAS/Civil finite element software is used to design and calculate the superstructure of the bridge. On the basis of the Grillage method, the whole model is established and the seismic checking calculation is carried out. The results show that the design of the bearing capacity limit state and the normal service limit state of the superstructure, as well as the seismic checking calculation of the bridge, all meet the requirements of the code; T-beam design is calculated by Grillage method, which makes the modeling and post-processing more intuitive, and provides more convenience for the later seismic checking calculation. The Grillage method is very suitable for the design of T-beam bridge.

articleTitle: Security of Big Data Based on the Technology of Cloud Computing
publicationTitle: 2019 4th International Conference on Mechanical, Control and Computer Engineering (ICMCCE)
abstract: To solve the problem of big data security and privacy protection, and expound the concept of cloud computing, big data and the relationship between them, the existing security and privacy protection method characteristic and problems were studied. A reference model is proposed which is based on cloud platform. In this model the physical level, data layer, interface layer and application layer step by step in to implement the system security risk early warning and threat perception, this provides an effective solution for the research of big data security. At the same time, a future research direction that uses the blockchain to solve cloud security and privacy protection is also pointed out.

articleTitle: Tennis Ball Machine Innovated in Control, Economy and Portability
publicationTitle: 2019 4th International Conference on Mechanical, Control and Computer Engineering (ICMCCE)
abstract: Tennis ball machine has great performance in tennis training and is prevailing among tennis players. However, three major problems of contemporary products-inaccurate control, high cost, and poor portability have hindered the ball machine from realizing its further potential in training. To solve these problems, our team looks into many popular brands and their products, such as Tennistutor, Playmate, Prince and Lobster, EI papers of ball machine design and other similar ball servers, such as the serving robots in Robomaster. We compare different structures and their performances and come to the conclusion that it is the arrangement of guide rail that mainly leads to the control problem. Therefore, we design a delivering mechanism, in where guide rail is arranged in an almost horizontal angle, and to coordinate with it, a turntable mechanism, in which there are specially designed turntable and its outer barrel, a launching mechanism and a control system. And with reducing the space and weight of each mechanism, we can solve the three problems and explore further potential of the ball machine.

articleTitle: EMC Performance Analysis and Countermeasure of Electric Actuator Control System - Electrical Fast Transient/burst Problem Solving
publicationTitle: 2019 4th International Conference on Mechanical, Control and Computer Engineering (ICMCCE)
abstract: Aiming at electromagnetic compatibility problem caused by harsh electromagnetic environment of industrial process control on Intelligent Electric actuator control system, common types of interfaces received by intelligent electric actuators are discussed and corresponding countermeasures are proposed. Based on the international standard IEC 61000-4, an intelligent electric actuator of a certain type on the market was studied and tested. Results show that EFT / b (Electrical Fast Transient / Burst) interference is main cause of electric actuator failure, EFT / B interference threshold voltage is obtained by Gamma model. Hardware filtering and limiting filtering deal with EFT / B interference problem, and finally the tested device passes test.

articleTitle: The Simulation System of Ship Fixed Water Extinguishing Training Based on Virtual Reality Technique
publicationTitle: 2019 4th International Conference on Mechanical, Control and Computer Engineering (ICMCCE)
abstract: Because it is rough to teach and train student in real environment, the ship fixed water extinguishing simulation training system is built, which can not only restore the environment but also reduce the training cost. We use the modeling software (3D Max) to establish fixed water fire-fighting equipment models. And the HTC VIVE helmet is used to enhance the sense of reality and the Unity3D engine is used to set up the virtual scene of the ship. The students' movement is realized by Bezier curve. The operation to virtual equipment is realized by the collision detection. The route of the virtual crew is realized by the A* algorithm. The examination result illustrates that the training system can be applied to the fire-fighting training.

articleTitle: Research on Scenic Spots Recommendation Algorithm Based on Tourism Big Data
publicationTitle: 2019 4th International Conference on Mechanical, Control and Computer Engineering (ICMCCE)
abstract: In order to solve the data sparsity problem existing in the traditional collaborative filtering recommendation algorithm, a collaborative filtering recommendation algorithm for scenic spots based on multi-dimensional feature clustering was proposed. Firstly, the users are clustered and classified according to the feature vector. Then we determine the category of the target user. Building user-scenic spot score matrix, on this basis, the user-scenic spot attention matrix is added. In order to optimize the traditional similarity recommendation algorithm, the attention matrix and the score matrix are linearly combined with the balance factor to calculate the similarity between users. In addition, the similarity threshold is introduced to determine the similar neighbor set. And recommend scenic spots to the target user according to the users in similar neighbor set. Finally, the MAE of the algorithm and the traditional recommendation algorithm are compared by using the tourism related data of Qingdao City crawled on the Mafengwo tourism website. The experimental results show that the algorithm proposed in the paper not only reduces the sparsity of data, but also improves the recommendation accuracy and has better stability.

articleTitle: An Improved Design of Intelligent Controller Based on Pattern Recognition
publicationTitle: 2019 4th International Conference on Mechanical, Control and Computer Engineering (ICMCCE)
abstract: In this paper we added a revising variable that reflect the system stability based on the control algorithm of the intelligent controller based on the pattern recognition to optimize the relevant performance indexes of the control system. Applying the fuzzy control theory to quantify the stability of system, a improved design method of intelligent controller based on the pattern recognition was advanced. The simulation results shown that, comparing with the optimized PID controller and the general controller based on pattern recognition, the control effect of the improved intelligent controller is improved in control indexes such as IAE integrating index, Overshoot and Response Time etc. The improved controller has better adaptability when the parameter and structure of the controlled object changed.

articleTitle: Design and Dynamic Performance Analysis of Brushless DC Motor Operating Mechanism for UHV Bypass Switch
publicationTitle: 2019 4th International Conference on Mechanical, Control and Computer Engineering (ICMCCE)
abstract: In order to meet the special requirements of the ultra-high voltage (UHV) high-speed bypass switch, the structure of the operating mechanism needs to be re-optimized. The target parameters of the operating mechanism are analyzed in this paper. Combined with the mechanical structure and load characteristics of the bypass switch, the permanent magnet brushless DC motor operating mechanism is designed. The parameters of the stator, electric load, magnetic load, pole pair number, air gap, pole arc coefficient and slenderness ratio are optimized. The simulation results show that the permanent magnet brushless DC motor can realize the opening and closing operation of the bypass switch and meet the speed characteristic requirements of the SF6 interrupter, which verifies the rationality of the design.

articleTitle: Design of Hidden Communication Remote Monitoring Based on C / C MFC
publicationTitle: 2019 4th International Conference on Mechanical, Control and Computer Engineering (ICMCCE)
abstract: This program is mainly based on remote monitoring program in C/C++ MFC production of hidden communication and can simulate the basic the Trojans operation and realization of the principle, we understand that the Trojans makes prevention program. Basic communications framework in line with the Trojan, and the code is simple, clear annotations, and to make a foundation for further learning Trojans.

articleTitle: 3D Printer Self-Adaptive Levelling Algorithm and Structure Design
publicationTitle: 2019 4th International Conference on Mechanical, Control and Computer Engineering (ICMCCE)
abstract: Levelling the base-plate of 3D printer is an important process before printing, and it has a great impact on the printing quality and success rate. In view of the low efficiency and low precision of conventional 3D printer levelling, this paper proposes a self-adaptive levelling algorithm and its structure design, aiming to improve the printing precision and success rate.

articleTitle: Research and Implementation of Key Technology of HIL Architecture Design Based on xPC Real-Time Platform
publicationTitle: 2019 4th International Conference on Mechanical, Control and Computer Engineering (ICMCCE)
abstract: This paper builds a typical HIL system based on the xPC real-time platform, expounds the system architecture and function implementation, and mainly completes the implementation of standardized information management, flexible calling module and online parameter adjustment. Through the interface between C++ and MATLAB engine, establish a seamless connection between interactive system and Simulink, complete the construction and compilation of the model. The data communication between the host and the target machine is established through the TCP/IP protocol, the compiled file is downloaded to the target machine, and the target machine receives the downloaded control strategy and runs in real time. And we use MySQL to improve data management. System function integration based on Qt, LabVIEW and dynamic link library. At last, we take the typical control system as an example to verify the effectiveness of development techniques.

articleTitle: Optimal Design of Ultra-Thin Seats Based on Ergonomics
publicationTitle: 2019 4th International Conference on Mechanical, Control and Computer Engineering (ICMCCE)
abstract: In this paper, the optimum design of airplane seat is carried out, combined with ergonomics, the parameters of comfortable sitting posture of human body are inversed and analyzed. The equations of coccyx and lumbar vertebrae were established, and the fitting equation of the center line of seat backrest was obtained. After establishing the physiological evaluation model, the stress of the seat is analyzed by ANSYS software, and the pressure effect diagram of the seat is obtained. The thickness of the seat in the sitting position joint, front leg, back waist and other parts is determined to be 6 cm, 3 cm, 4 cm and 3 cm, respectively.

articleTitle: Application of Portable Ultrasonic Flow Sensor in Aircraft Hydraulic System
publicationTitle: 2019 4th International Conference on Mechanical, Control and Computer Engineering (ICMCCE)
abstract: Flow rate is not only an important parameter to ensure the normal operation of hydraulic system, but also the characteristic information of fault detection and condition monitoring of hydraulic system, which has important engineering significance. This paper describes an ultrasonic sensor for flow measurement of aircraft hydraulic pipeline and its detection principle. The ultrasonic probe can be installed on the outer wall of the pipeline with an appropriate fixture to achieve non-contact measurement without breaking or stopping to installation. After wavelet transform and the two-series filter of median filtering and mean filtering, the experimental results show that the ultrasonic flow sensor has the advantages of simple installation, convenient use and high accuracy, and can meet the needs of practical engineering.

articleTitle: A Combination of Prefixed-Itemset and Database Optimization to Improve Apriori Algorithm on Hadoop Cluster
publicationTitle: 2019 4th International Conference on Mechanical, Control and Computer Engineering (ICMCCE)
abstract: Apriori algorithm is a classical algorithm in the field of data mining. It is widely used in the research of mining the association rules, but it also has some disadvantages. In this paper, for the three main steps in the execution of the Apriori algorithm, we propose a novel method that combines the storage structure of the prefixed-itemset with the database optimization to improve the Apriori algorithm on the Hadoop cluster. First, we used the storage structure of the prefixed-itemset to improve the implementation methods of the connection step and the pruning step in the traditional Apriori algorithm to increase the execution efficiency of the algorithm. Second, we changed the storage schema of the database. And we converted the original transaction database into the transaction-state matrix to transform the storage pattern of transaction data and enhance the efficiency of the traditional Apriori algorithm in the counting step. Then, we combined the properties of the frequent itemsets to improve the iterative termination condition of the algorithm, thus reduced the running time of the algorithm. Finally, we performed MapReduce parallelization improvement on the Apriori algorithm optimized by the above steps based on the Hadoop distributed architecture. The experimental results show that compared with the traditional Apriori algorithm, the improved Apriori algorithm on the Hadoop cluster has improved the execution efficiency greatly.

articleTitle: Research on New Font Generation System Based on Generative Adversarial Network
publicationTitle: 2019 4th International Conference on Mechanical, Control and Computer Engineering (ICMCCE)
abstract: This paper describes a font generation system based on generative adversarial networks, which aims to automatically form artistic fonts and calligraphy copybooks. The generative adversarial network is trained in the way of adversarial learning in order to estimate the potential distribution of the samples so as to generate new data samples. With this model, the system can generate new fonts that are consistent with the original font form but different in style by extracting and synthesizing the font characteristics under the large sample set.

articleTitle: Failure Mechanism Analysis and Diagnosis Related to Packaging of Lamp LED
publicationTitle: 2019 4th International Conference on Mechanical, Control and Computer Engineering (ICMCCE)
abstract: Packaging structure is one of the important field of device quality. In order to help the engineers to improve quality level and reduce the failure rate in using of lamp LED product, we should realize the failure mode, failure mechanisms and root causes of lamp LED package. Method: First, more than 100 failure analysis cases about lamp LED package have been carried out by the authors. And the authors made a summary of these cases. The main failure modes of lamp LED package are introduced. Then, based on these failure modes, the possible mechanism of each type of failure mode and the root causes of failures are analyzed in detail.
