Finally, A lot of cases are used to support the analysis in this article. Result: all failure modes, corresponding failure mechanisms and root causes are summarized in a form for reference to engineers and technicians engaged in failure analysis and product improvement. Conclusion: The failure mode of lamp LED package in the use is no light, or intermittently no light, or the intensity of light is weak. But its failure mechanism and related reasons are directing to packaging process, structure and materials.

articleTitle: Evaluation of Smart City Construction Level Based on Context- Dependent Data Envelopment Analysis
publicationTitle: 2019 4th International Conference on Mechanical, Control and Computer Engineering (ICMCCE)
abstract: Smart city is one of the themes of the 13th Five-Year Plan. This paper evaluates the development level of smart city from the perspective of input-output system with context-dependent data envelopment method. First, the input-output index system is established, and then, the hierarchical analysis method divides 32 cities into 3 levels. Finally, the attraction value and improvement value based on different evaluation background are proposed as instructive reference when supplying suggestions for individual city . The research shows that the construction of smart cities in China is still in the development process, and there are drama differences between the regions. Accounting for this, this paper provides some ideas for smart city construction as a reference.

articleTitle: Based on Embedded Zerotree Wavelet Coding Data Compression Algorithm Research of NC Machine Tool Control System
publicationTitle: 2019 4th International Conference on Mechanical, Control and Computer Engineering (ICMCCE)
abstract: the core of intelligent manufacturing is Cyber-Physical system. In order to establish high frequency sampling of Cyber-Physical system, massive data is needed. It is necessary to study the efficient transmission technology of real-time data. Data compression is through the omitted part is not necessary or redundant, transfer and storage in finite strip width, and storage space for more information of a technical means. Embedded Wavelet coding (Embedded Zero tree Wavelet, EZW) is based on Wavelet transform multi-resolution analysis technology, extract the Embedded Zero tree, and variable length of quantization and coding compression, transmission and decompression algorithm. This paper mainly studies the numerical control machine tool electric control instruction domain representative of the current loop of data in the data for one dimensional data was designed based on the EZW algorithm binary tree structure of zero tree and Huffman encoding to achieve further compression. Verification experiment and application results showed that, the algorithm on the basis of the guarantee accuracy has good compression ratio and efficiency.

articleTitle: Component Fusion Image Encryption Method Based on Composite Chaotic Model
publicationTitle: 2019 4th International Conference on Mechanical, Control and Computer Engineering (ICMCCE)
abstract: In order to improve the security and encryption performance of component fusion image encryption, a method of component fusion image encryption is proposed based on composite chaotic model. A component fusion image is decomposed into three grayscale images, and a composite chaotic model is constructed by using Logistic chaotic map and Hyperhenon chaotic map, and the chaotic algorithm is combined with traditional cyclic encryption. The chaotic system with dynamic initial conditions is used to generate three pseudorandom sequences to encrypt the fused image. The encryption key generated by the logistic chaotic sequence is replaced by the encryption key in the Hyperhenon chaotic sequence to generate the image encryption sequence. The vector quantization coding of image encryption is carried out by piecewise linear chaotic mapping, and the optimal design of image encryption algorithm is realized. The simulation results show that the proposed method has good fusion performance and strong anti-attack ability to ensure the security and stability of image transmission.

articleTitle: A Typical Remote Sensing Object Detection Method Based on YOLOv3
publicationTitle: 2019 4th International Conference on Mechanical, Control and Computer Engineering (ICMCCE)
abstract: considering the problem of typical remote sensing object detection, this paper proposes an improved remote sensing object detection method based on YOLOv3 algorithm. A new activation function is designed automatically by genetic algorithm. The classification task training result of the convolutional neural network on remote sensing image is used as the evaluation function of genetic algorithm. The function enhances its nonlinear transformation ability to remote sensing features; then the activation function is embedded in the YOLOv3 algorithm, and the object detection task is trained on the self-made typical remote sensing target dataset. The experimental results show that the method can significantly improve the detection accuracy of various typical remote sensing targets.

articleTitle: Method for Constructing Data Model Of Enterprise Relationship Graph Based on Industrial and Commercial Data
publicationTitle: 2019 4th International Conference on Mechanical, Control and Computer Engineering (ICMCCE)
abstract: The method relies on the commercial bank system architecture, reuses the external business data query service of the commercial banking system, integrates the data warehouse data processing capability, provides the association data to the map presentation tool, and constructs the enterprise relationship map data model. Thereby a relational graph model generates and provides the bank with the data needed under the customized query. The core technology of the method is to design the relational graph database model and explore the national publicity data. The construction of the relationship map helps to improve the bank's ability to acquire new customers, as well as to fully understand existing customers, create customer portraits, and help banks prevent group customers' group risks. In the field of procurement business, in order to avoid the bidding and stringing between suppliers, the method establishes the actual controller algorithm to understand whether there is a relationship between suppliers, what is the relationship, provide data support for procurement decisions.

articleTitle: Personalized Automatic Driving System Based on Reinforcement Learning Technology
publicationTitle: 2019 4th International Conference on Mechanical, Control and Computer Engineering (ICMCCE)
abstract: This paper proposes and designs a personalized automatic driving learning system. First, based on the current driving operation and habits of the driver, machine vision, and vehicle sensing, this paper extracts several index parameters using the driving simulator as a data collecting tool during the manual driving process. Then, this paper identifies the characteristics of the driving style, based on which the driving decision algorithm adopting deep reinforcement learning is trained in order to ensure that the self-driving vehicle can operate in accordance with the driving style and that the riding can be more comfortable and safer.

articleTitle: Application of Improved OPTICS Algorithm in Intelligent Lighting System
publicationTitle: 2019 4th International Conference on Mechanical, Control and Computer Engineering (ICMCCE)
abstract: Recently, Manual control of lighting system is still the main force in most huge events and situations, which contribute serious waste of electricity. For the tobacco distribution center, there are special lighting management methods, such as setting a uniform time to open and close the lighting equipment in the joint workshop. Although a certain amount of electric energy can be saved by this means, it cannot meet the actual demand. In the essay, according to the actual situation of tobacco distribution center joint workshop, the OPTICS Algorithm is improved to conduct cluster analysis on the location data of personnel in the workshop, finding out the illume area where the personnel are relatively densely distributed. Besides, it can also calculate the number of lamps that need to be turned on under the condition of meeting the specified illumination. The experimental results demonstrate that the energy saving effect is particularly obvious when the people are widely distributed in the lighting places.

articleTitle: Straight Track Tracking of Paddle Boat Based on Kalman Filter
publicationTitle: 2019 4th International Conference on Mechanical, Control and Computer Engineering (ICMCCE)
abstract: Linear orbit tracking algorithm of navigation for aquaculture paddle boat. Based on the motion coordinate system, after the establishment of the paddle boat hydrodynamic model, the transfer function and state equation of the paddle boat yaw angle system, the sliding mode control method is adopted to achieving high-precision track tracking for the paddle boat. In order to save the energy, reduce the active frequency of the control system caused by the disturbance, and extend the duration of sailing of the paddle boat, the Kalman filter is proposed to reduce the influence of the disturbance on the track tracking. The simulation and experimental verification show that the sliding mode control method based on Kalman filter can realize high-precision linear track tracking, and Kalman filter can effectively reduce the influence of disturbance.

articleTitle: Deep Learning for Topmost Roller Chain Detection Using Data Augmentation
publicationTitle: 2019 4th International Conference on Mechanical, Control and Computer Engineering (ICMCCE)
abstract: Positioning topmost object from a pile of metal sheets using image processing is a typical topic in the field of industry. Relative new methodologies mainly focus on improving robustness under complex state based on deep learning. While deep learning and CNN have demonstrated capacity in instance segmentation, the preparation of dataset is time consuming. To accelerate the preparation, this paper proposes a data augmentation technique that can simulate imaging features of roller chains and generates a large dataset. Experiments of roller chains show no significant difference between the dataset by manually annotating and the dataset by data augmentation. And the methodology reduces manual annotation by 99.9% and needs few labors.

articleTitle: Research and Implementation of User-Level Load Forecasting Based on Load Model Library with Electric Data
publicationTitle: 2019 4th International Conference on Mechanical, Control and Computer Engineering (ICMCCE)
abstract: According to reliable survey data, the number of domestic electricity companies in China has exceeded 20,000. All provinces in the country are actively preparing for the reform of the spot market. In 2019 and 2020, the spot market in Guangdong, Zhejiang and other provinces will land. At that time, the profitability and load forecasting ability of each power supply company are the important links that must be considered in pushing the power supply company to the market. Power supply company's contract strategy, quotation strategy, transaction strategy and economic calculation of individual customers are very important, which will affect the vital interests of the power supply company. Especially for a single customer with huge power consumption, it is necessary to have a precise contract scheme to meet the needs of large customers. Therefore, it is not right to carry out user-level load forecasting. The forecast of the transformation and upgrading of the electricity market is forward-looking and urgent. With the basic data of electricity customers having a certain foundation, data analysis based on power data has a necessary foundation for accurate calculation and prediction of user-level load.

articleTitle: Research on the Architecture of NQI One-Stop Service Cloud Platform in Smart Grid Measurement Field
publicationTitle: 2019 4th International Conference on Mechanical, Control and Computer Engineering (ICMCCE)
abstract: The basic situation of NQI (National Quality Infrastructure) in the field of smart grid measurement is introduced. Aiming at the information requirement of NQI in the field of smart grid measurement, the construction scheme and purpose of NQI one-stop service cloud platform are proposed. The technical architecture of cloud platform is studied, the operation and security management of cloud platform are introduced. The data architecture of cloud platform is studied, the data access scheme and data acquisition method are designed in accordance with the current business situation, and the data model based on NQI is proposed. The application architecture of cloud platform is studied, and the service design of cloud platform is discussed according to the application goal of cloud platform. Finally, the further development of cloud platform and its application in real business are prospected.

articleTitle: Review of Research Progress on Small Sample Learning
publicationTitle: 2019 4th International Conference on Mechanical, Control and Computer Engineering (ICMCCE)
abstract: The neural network model has achieved very good results in the field of computer vision, but the requirements for the amount of data are directly proportional to performance. Data hungry is not only the cause of the high performance of the neural network model, but also a hindrance to its further development. There is not a lot of available data in real-world application scenarios, so how to obtain better performance and more robust models in a small sample environment becomes the goal of less sample learning research. This paper reviews the past small sample learning methods, sorts out its performance and theoretical principles, and points out the existing deficiencies and proposes possible future research directions.

articleTitle: Research on the Practice of Course Ideological and Political Education in Applied Undergraduate Colleges
publicationTitle: 2019 4th International Conference on Mechanical, Control and Computer Engineering (ICMCCE)
abstract: The Application-oriented Undergraduate Colleges and universities with professional knowledge serving the local economic development narrow the gap between vulnerabilities and the requirements of enterprises through ideological and political education. At the same time, students should set up correct socialist core values and train high-quality application-oriented talents, which is more competitive. Competitive. Based on the course of "Electronic Commerce Technology Foundation", the ideological and political content of the course is designed from the aspects of socialist core values, social responsibility, innovation and entrepreneurship ability, social practice ability, etc. The ideological and political education system of the whole course is constructed, and the effective ways of integrating the learning of curriculum professional knowledge with the practice of ideological and political content are explored. It is hoped that through the teaching reform, comprehensive quality and professional ability will be improved, and students' career development potential will be increased.

articleTitle: Research on the Current Situation of the Application of Artificial Intelligence in Media Field and Countermeasures
publicationTitle: 2019 4th International Conference on Mechanical, Control and Computer Engineering (ICMCCE)
abstract: With the progress of modern media technology and the rise of the intelligent waves, the media form continues to enrich, and the form and production mode of news reports gradually become increasingly diverse. The integration of intelligent technology and traditional news represents the new trend of the future development of the media industry. This paper analyses the connotation of AI and its application in the media industry. The media industry will enter a new era in which all things are media, all things are interconnected and screen-free coexistence. The changes in communication process, efficiency and form do not replace the media, but serve the human society. By enumerating and analyzing practical application of AI application in media, the machine news product form under the background of artificial intelligence, application generality and its influence on the media industry are introduced and discussed in this paper, and further some suggestions on optimizing the development path of intelligent media are put forward to shed some lights on the future development of the media industry.

articleTitle: Research on Data Processing Method of Air Quality Monitoring System
publicationTitle: 2019 4th International Conference on Mechanical, Control and Computer Engineering (ICMCCE)
abstract: In order to improve the efficiency of air quality monitoring system processing and analyzing large amounts of data, an air quality monitoring system based on BP neural network is constructed to intelligently process the data collected in real time. A new data processing method integrating ROLAP technology and BP neural network was proposed. The method uses the ROLAP system to combine multiple relational databases into multi-dimensional star structures. The BP neural network accurately classify air quality according to AQI to the corresponding level. The uncached data is classified into cache cells with the lowest degree of dissimilarity and then followed by a linear regression function to monitor the rate of change. The experimental results show that two technologies are successfully integrated, and the data storage and classification dimensions are increased. Compared with the traditional device, the information query rate and accuracy are improved, and the average response time of the system is reduced from 60ms to less than 20ms. The sensitivity of the system is improved by monitoring the data change rate. The function of warning abnormal data was achieved.

articleTitle: Analyze Impact of Private Equity Investment on the Growth of Small and Medium-Sized Enterprises by big Data Technology
publicationTitle: 2019 4th International Conference on Mechanical, Control and Computer Engineering (ICMCCE)
abstract: After over 30 years of reform and opening up, China's total GDP and economic scale have leaped to the second place on a global scale, but its quality and industrial structure still need to be availably adjusted. The transformation and upgrading of industries need financial support, while the traditional financial system puts a too high premium on the financing of large enterprises and state-owned enterprises, and cannot availably address the development of China's small, medium-sized and micro enterprises as well as innovative economy. At this time, an increasing number of private equity companies are becoming investors in small and medium enterprises. Hence, in the context of the times, this paper attempts to explore the impact of private equity investment on the growth of SMEs, and establish multiple linear regression equations for empirical analysis with the data of all New Three Board enterprises listed from 2015 to 2018. The study reveals that no matter adding control variables or not, private equity investment exerts a significant positive impact on the growth rate of SMEs. Through heterogeneity analysis, it is found that the impact is not the same for different industries. This paper offers a new point of view for understanding the growth of SMEs and can be used as a reference for future policy formulation.

articleTitle: Constructing ECU Software Architecture Based on OSEK
publicationTitle: 2019 4th International Conference on Mechanical, Control and Computer Engineering (ICMCCE)
abstract: with the growing of the automotive industry and the increasing demands of automotive functions, the processor-based electronic control units become more powerful, their design and development become more complex. Therefore, there is a need for developing an ECU hardware and software to implement its complex functions. An ECU embedded software architecture based on OSEK is defined in this paper, which is constructed by external applications, RTOS API, RTOS-kernel, hardware abstraction layer and hardware. This ECU software architecture is also platform independent. The purpose is aiming to reduce the complexity of the ECU software design, and to improve systematic real-time, safety and stability.

articleTitle: Grid Monitoring Alarm Event Recognition Method Integrating Expert Rules and Deep Learning
publicationTitle: 2019 4th International Conference on Mechanical, Control and Computer Engineering (ICMCCE)
abstract: SCADA collects a large amount of alarm information during the power system operation. If the controller cannot quickly judge the monitoring alarm events, it may cause the expansion of the accident. Therefore, we propose a grid monitoring alarm event recognition method combining expert rules and deep learning. The method includes two stages: expert knowledge base determination and deep learning recognition model determination. In the first stage, the characteristics and rules related to monitoring alarm events are sorted, the expert knowledge base is constructed, and the alarm events are initially identified. In the second stage, the preliminary judgment results and the alarm information are combined into the convolutional neural network (CNN) recognition model, thus the final recognition result is obtained.

articleTitle: Improvement of the Carrier Phase Based on Vector Frequency Locked Loop with the Phase Locked Loop Assisted
publicationTitle: 2019 4th International Conference on Mechanical, Control and Computer Engineering (ICMCCE)
abstract: Vector frequency locked loop (VFLL) uses the information which is the velocity and the clock drift from the receiver and satellites to predict the carrier frequency in each channel. However, VFLL is not precise enough to lock the carrier phase, which does not demodulate the received signal correctly. To address this problem, this paper presents a method based on the vector frequency locked loop with the Phase Locked Loop (PLL) assisted. Firstly, the proposed method adds the output of the loop filter of the carrier phase discriminator to the prediction of the carrier frequency, which enhances the precision of the carrier phase of VFLL. Then, by means of compensating the residual of the carrier phase, the accuracy of demodulation value is improved. Simulation results of simulated data test and real data test demonstrate that the performance of the proposed method outperforms the VFLL in term of the carrier phase and demodulation value.

articleTitle: A Sequential Hybrid Wideband Beamforming in Millimeter Wave MIMO Systems
publicationTitle: 2019 4th International Conference on Mechanical, Control and Computer Engineering (ICMCCE)
abstract: Millimeter wave (mmWave) experiences more path loss than lower frequencies currently used in the wireless communication systems. Therefore, desirable hybrid beamforming with enough antenna gain should be designed for the mmWave system to provide promising high data rates for the next generation communication system. However, compared with the sub-connected structure using wideband architecture, current works mainly focus on the fully-connected structure under narrowband, which achieves limited sum-rate gains with much power consumption. In this paper, we consider studying the sub-connected wideband mmWave system and propose a frequency selective wideband hybrid beamforming technique. Furthermore, we design a frequency selective sequential hybrid wideband beamforming technique using the sub-connected structure to improve the sum-rate, where each sub-carrier finds beamformer for each sub-antenna array by choosing the beamformer nearest to the optimal. By taking advantage of the sub-connected structure, the proposed beamforming method can be elaborated to suppress the interference effectively. Simulation results show significant improvement in the sum-rate performance of the proposed method when compared with other existing methods.

articleTitle: Prediction of Indoor Wireless LAN Field Strength Distribution Based on Ray Tracing Method
publicationTitle: 2019 4th International Conference on Mechanical, Control and Computer Engineering (ICMCCE)
abstract: Since the indoor propagation environment is complex, it is difficult to accurately establish the signal multipath propagation model, which affects the accuracy of indoor wireless LAN field strength resolution. This paper improves the indoor wireless LAN signal multipath model by using the ray tracing method to simulate the real wave propagation more accurately. The path is computed by the indoor environment modeling, and compared with the measured data, the average error is within 2dB, which proves the effectiveness of the ray tracing method in solving the field coverage problem of indoor wireless LAN.

articleTitle: Research on Standardization Strategy of Improving Economic Benefits of Machinery Manufacturing Enterprises in China
publicationTitle: 2019 4th International Conference on Mechanical, Control and Computer Engineering (ICMCCE)
abstract: This paper analyzes the current problems of China's machinery manufacturing enterprises, analyzes the mechanism of the improvement of corporate standard economic benefits, and puts forward the preliminary ideas of maximizing economic benefits through moderate standardization, and specific suggestions for improving the standardization economic benefits of enterprises are given.

articleTitle: Research on the Topology of a Custom Power Device for Electric Vehicle Charging Station
publicationTitle: 2019 4th International Conference on Mechanical, Control and Computer Engineering (ICMCCE)
abstract: As a result of large-scale electric vehicles starting charging at a station, power quality problems, such as voltage sags, will occur in the power grid. Based on this, a custom power device called Dynamic Voltage Restorer (DVR) is proposed to be connected to the electric vehicle charging station to deal with power quality problems. Considering that the filter capacitor can be set at different locations of DVR, i.e. parallel connection at converter side, line side and load side, this paper compares and analyses the mathematical models of three different topologies of DVR, and points out that the disturbance suppression ability of the topology of filter capacitor parallel on load side is relatively strongest, which is more suitable for the application of electric vehicle charging station.

articleTitle: Dynamic Simulation and Thermal Analysis of Rock Breaking Force on Disc Cutter of Tunnel Boring Machine
publicationTitle: 2019 4th International Conference on Mechanical, Control and Computer Engineering (ICMCCE)
abstract: The disc hob is a key component of the roadheader and its stress is complicated during the rock breaking process. In this paper, the finite element simulation analysis is carried out based on the external and internal actual force conditions of the disc hob. The research shows the rock breaking force of the hob is changing at any time. Through the thermal simulation during the rock-breaking process of the disc hob, it is found the thermal stress change trend is basically consistent with the temperature change trend. The value of the tool tip area is the largest and the value of the area farther from the tool tip is smaller. Through the comprehensive simulation analysis from different angles, it provides a certain basis for optimizing the structure of the disc hob, reducing the abnormal damage probability of the hob and prolonging the service life of the hob.

articleTitle: Research on a Hybrid Control Method for Three-Phase High-Power Energy Storage Converter
publicationTitle: 2019 4th International Conference on Mechanical, Control and Computer Engineering (ICMCCE)
abstract: The repetitive control technique is adopted to a bidirectional AC-DC system for storing electrical energy, which also can be used to enhance the performance of bidirectional power flow between the three-phase ac voltage source and energy storage equipment in this paper. In order to eliminate the influences of line harmonics and frequency disturbances, a closed-loop phase-locked loop (PLL) without any hardware filters is completely applied to software. Constant current (CC) and constant voltage (CV) charging, constant power (CP) discharging are realized by dq separated control method. For the sake of eliminating periodic interference and tracing the periodic disturbance signal, the compound control (PI-RC) of PI (proportion integration) controller plus repetitive control is designed. The realization of controller and algorithm is realized by single-core digital processor (DSP). The simulation and experiment results based on a 100 kW prototype topology demonstrate that the prototype has high performance of low total harmonic distortion (THD) current.

articleTitle: Study on the Role of Solid Surface on Nanochannel Flow with Molecular Dynamics Simulation
publicationTitle: 2019 4th International Conference on Mechanical, Control and Computer Engineering (ICMCCE)
abstract: The passage uses Molecular Dynamics method to investigate the influence of liquid-solid interaction, temperature, roughness and rigidity on number density distribution and slip velocity by simulating liquid argon Couette flow with nano-scale channel. The result shows that the number density of the liquid argon presents a damped layered distribution of fluctuation. In near region area, as interaction grows stronger and temperature is lower, number density increases, leading to slip velocity decrease. Liquid argon number density also decreases with rougher walls. More rigid wall leads to larger number density but has little influence on slip velocity. It is suggested that although more liquid argon atoms near the wall have higher possibility to collide with solid atoms, more rigid wall makes solid atoms amplitude decrease, making them harder to collide with liquid atoms. Thus, slip velocity has little difference.

articleTitle: Reliability Analysis of Conventional Island Water Supply System
publicationTitle: 2019 4th International Conference on Mechanical, Control and Computer Engineering (ICMCCE)
abstract: Go-flow method is an effective method to evaluate the reliability of complex systems with multi-timing characteristics, but at the same time, go-flow method has numerous operators and complex algorithms, which restricts the application of go-flow method in nuclear power reliability analysis. The reliability analysis method based on dynamic Bayesian network (DBN) is used to analyze the reliability of water supply system. Firstly, the mapping rules of go-flow operators to DBN nodes are defined. Then, according to the control logic and component characteristics of the water supply system, select the corresponding operator to establish the go-flow reliability model of the water supply system, and map the model to DBN model according to the corresponding rules. Finally, the mapped DBN model is quantitative solved. The sensitivity analysis (SA) of the model was carried out to obtain the influence degree of different components of the system. This method has the characteristics of high applicability, clear structure and fast computation.

articleTitle: Optimization Planning of Distribution Network Structure in Benxi Area Based on ant Colony Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2019 4th International Conference on Mechanical, Control and Computer Engineering (ICMCCE)
abstract: Ant colony algorithm(ACA) is a new general heuristic method for solving combinatorial optimization problems. The main features of this method are positive feedback, distributed computing and constructive greedy heuristic search. Distribution network grid optimization planning is a complex nonlinear combination optimization problem. In this paper, ACA is applied to the research of grid network optimization planning, and the mathematical model of grid planning is established. The model takes the minimum sum of the annual comprehensive cost and the overload penalty cost as the objective function. Based on the corresponding algorithm is designed. At the same time, the algorithm is applied to the planning of distribution network of Benxi City and the planning proposal of distribution network is put forward.

articleTitle: Original-Design-Intention-Driven Parametric Surface Reconstruction Method
publicationTitle: 2019 4th International Conference on Mechanical, Control and Computer Engineering (ICMCCE)
abstract: The conventional surface reconstruction methods and software can create a similar surface model with physical model by directly fitting faces to corresponding point cloud data and combining them. But for some special application which requires a consistency 3D parametric model with original design logic and engineering rules, previous methods are very inefficient or even impossible. This paper presents a new design-intention-driven surface reconstruction method to solve this kind of problems. A multi-stage optimization mechanism basing on sensitivity analysis will optimize the many design variables in this imprecise model driven by original design intentions and minimize the deviation between model and point cloud to a level of manufacturing tolerance. And then the engineers obtain the consistency model as well as the key design parameters for improving design, deriving new products and later processing. This paper uses the raceway surface reconstruction of Birfield ball-joint as an example to illustrate this method.

articleTitle: Study on Trajectory Planning of Parafoil Homing Under Variable Wind Field
publicationTitle: 2019 4th International Conference on Mechanical, Control and Computer Engineering (ICMCCE)
abstract: The variable wind field is one of the most important factors that affects the homing precision of parafoil system. K-means clustering method is used to analyze the measured wind field data of one month in a certain area, and two clustering centers are obtained according to the wind field in the morning and evening. Adopt three-segments homing methods for trajectory planning in the two variable wind field clustering centers, and two planned trajectories as well as the control variables are solved. Take the two clustering centers as the wind field input and control variables as the control input in parafoil four degree of freedom dynamics model and solve two simulated trajectories. Compare the planned trajectories and simulated trajectories in clustering centers, results show that their coincidence degree is extremely, which proves the effectiveness of the homing algorithm. Compare the two planned trajectories in two clustering centers, results show that the effect of wind field can be eliminated by changing the initial position.

articleTitle: Research on the Calculation of Accumulated Fatigue Damage for Ship Structures
publicationTitle: 2019 4th International Conference on Mechanical, Control and Computer Engineering (ICMCCE)
abstract: Based on the direct analysis, three methods to calculate the accumulated fatigue damage for ship structures are addressed. They are based on the short-term distribution, the long-term distribution fitted from short-term distribution and a significant stress calculation. The corresponding formulations and flow charts are presented for each methods, respectively. The results show that the calculated accumulated fatigue damage varies from each other and much attention should be paid.

articleTitle: Synchro-Control of Twin-Rudder for Ship
publicationTitle: 2019 4th International Conference on Mechanical, Control and Computer Engineering (ICMCCE)
abstract: Aiming at the ships which have twin-rudder, the motion of two rudders does not synchronous because of the difference of structure parameters and electrical parameter caused by environment in two steering gear systems. The efficiency of the rudder will decrease and the maneuverability of the ship will change. Theory modeling of steering gear system is given in this paper, and the synchroballistic control structure is designed according to the follow-up control strategy. Variable universe theory is introduced to improve the control precision under various working condition. And the variable universe adaptive fuzzy PID synchroballistic controller is proposed. The validity and reliability of the controller are proved by simulation. This method has guiding significance for engineering application.

articleTitle: Optimization of Z Coal Mine Inventory Management Research
publicationTitle: 2019 4th International Conference on Mechanical, Control and Computer Engineering (ICMCCE)
abstract: With the rapid development of the logistics industry, inventory management, as the most important link in the logistics system, has been paid more and more attention by enterprises. This paper takes the Z coal mine warehouse as the research object, selecting different management objectives for different types of inventory, putting forward reasonable optimization schemes. This paper selects the test rating of the optimization scheme, comparing and analyzing the changes of the model before and after optimization. Finally, it is found that the optimization scheme is of great help to improve the inventory management, reducing the inventory, increasing the inventory turnover rate, reducing the total cost and improving the service level. This study has certain reference value for solving the optimization of inventory management of relevant enterprises.

articleTitle: Reliability Design of Feeder Mechanism for Round Baler
publicationTitle: 2019 4th International Conference on Mechanical, Control and Computer Engineering (ICMCCE)
abstract: Reliability design is to evaluate the reliability of an optimization design method. This paper aims at the reliability design of the problem of easy blockage of the round baler. First, this paper analyzes and studies the cause of clogged round baler. Secondly, the design of feeder mechanism is optimized and it's 3D modeling is carried out by SOLIDWORKS. Finally, it is imported into the finite element analysis software ANSYS Workbench, modal calculation and statics analysis of the model are built, and the first 6 natural frequencies are extracted. The results show that the maximum working speed of the feed roller is far lower than the critical speed of the first order. The stress is mainly concentrated on the position of the shaft head, the feed roller and the connection position between the feed roller and the screw conveyor, far less than the material yield strength. This shows that the feeder mechanism meets the reliability requirements. The design and results provide theoretical guidance for the lean design of key components such as round baler feeder mechanisms. statics analysis.

articleTitle: Out-of-Plane Buckling Analysis of Cable-Beam Structure using Absolute Nodal Coordinate Formulation
publicationTitle: 2019 4th International Conference on Mechanical, Control and Computer Engineering (ICMCCE)
abstract: In this paper, the out-of-plane buckling analysis of cable-beam structure is studied using the Absolute Nodal Coordinate Formulation (ANCF). The presented numerical technique utilizes two ANCF elements i.e. the three dimensional cable element and the three dimensional higher order beam element. The results obtained from the presented approach are compared with the analytical results and were found to be in good agreement.

articleTitle: Research and Application of Sorting Method for Chang Back Smart Electricity Meter
publicationTitle: 2019 4th International Conference on Mechanical, Control and Computer Engineering (ICMCCE)
abstract: With the wide application and the popularization of electricity meter in State Grid, various faults often occur to the electricity meter which is often subject to various types of interference. To realize the effective application of electricity meter in the whole life cycle, the sorting of chang back smart electricity meters has been carried out by the State Grid Corporation. However, the sorting efficiency and results are seriously affected by the chaotic sorting items and the frequent failure of sorting device. To solve the problems and to realize the efficient sorting and reusing of the electricity meter, the techniques of sorting for the change back meter were carefully analyzed, the modular design method is applied to the sorting device, the sorting process is optimized and the closed-loop system architecture is designed, in this way, the efficient sorting and the collaborative analysis of sorting data can be realized for the change back meter, which makes the quality management for the life cycle of electricity meter being optimized.

articleTitle: Typical Structure Centrifuge Design Calculation Application
publicationTitle: 2019 4th International Conference on Mechanical, Control and Computer Engineering (ICMCCE)
abstract: The calculation process of the design calculation of the centrifuge structure is proposed, and the finite element analysis and calculation of the typical components of the centrifuge are carried out, and the optimization analysis of the structural design is realized. The corresponding modal analysis calculation process is proposed in the design of the centrifuge base, and the rotating parts of the centrifuge are calculated and analyzed, and applied to the actual calculation. Provide calculation references for future centrifuge design calculations to ensure design time savings in future design calculations.

articleTitle: A Traffic Intersection Monitoring System Model Based on Video Detection and GPRS Communication
publicationTitle: 2019 4th International Conference on Mechanical, Control and Computer Engineering (ICMCCE)
abstract: For some chaotic traffic scenes caused by accidents, major activities or bad weather in certain sections or areas, the traditional traffic monitoring system can not work effectively, due to the fact that the sensing coil can not be laid in advance. To solve the problem, a design scheme and monitoring method of traffic monitoring device based on video detection and GPRS communication is presented. This traffic monitoring scheme can realize data interaction between temporary monitoring points and traffic monitoring command center without laying sensor coils and networking in advance.

articleTitle: Simulation Study on the Working Process of Diesel Engine with Injection Strategy Coupled EGR
publicationTitle: 2019 4th International Conference on Mechanical, Control and Computer Engineering (ICMCCE)
abstract: in this paper, electronically controlled high pressure common rail diesel engine is taken as the research model, and the effect of post-injection parameters (main to post-injection angle and proportion of fuel injection), post-injection timing and exhaust-gas recirculation (EGR) on engine energy distribution and emission characteristics is mainly studied. The research shows that the adoption of smaller main to post-injection angle and larger post-injection amount is beneficial to reduce NOx emission and exhaust loss, improve efficiency; but it is not benefit to the improvement of heat transfer loss. With the delay of main injection timing, torque first rises and then falls; Exhaust loss increases obviously near top dead center (TDC), heat transfer loss decrease gradually. When the main injection timing is in a certain angle before TDC, with the increasing of the EGR rate, the torque is not significantly reduced, and the BSFC is good, while the NOx emission is greatly reduced. Therefore, reasonable timing of main injection and proper increasing of EGR rate are benefit to improving the trade-off relationship between NOx and fuel consumption. Compared with single injection, multiple injection coupled injection timing can reduce NOx emission to a certain extent.

articleTitle: Genetic Algorithm Based Optimal Strategy for Smart Home Energy Management System with Solar Power and Electric Vehicle
publicationTitle: 2019 4th International Conference on Mechanical, Control and Computer Engineering (ICMCCE)
abstract: With the progress of automation control technology, residential buildings become more and more intelligent. Home energy management in active distribution power grid connecting renewable energy and electric vehicle has received increasing interest. In this paper, typical structures about the smart home energy management system (SHEMS) is revealed. To reduce the customer electricity bill, an optimal strategy of SHEMS is proposed. The results from simulation show to us that the proposed strategy gives people who live in smart home a more economical and comfortable life.

articleTitle: Relaxed Algorithm for Solving the Split Feasibility Problem with Para-Monotone Equilibrium and Convex Optimization
publicationTitle: 2019 4th International Conference on Mechanical, Control and Computer Engineering (ICMCCE)
abstract: In this article, we propose a relaxed algorithm for the split feasibility problem involving para-monotone equilibrium and convex optimization, which doesn't need the information of the operator norm. It improves the feasibility and application range of the algorithm. And we prove the strong convergence of the algorithm.

articleTitle: Research on Mobile User Behavior Mining Model Based on Big Data
publicationTitle: 2019 4th International Conference on Mechanical, Control and Computer Engineering (ICMCCE)
abstract: With the development of mobile Internet, the research of mobile user behavior based on big data has become one of the hotspots in the field of mobile Internet. Based on the analysis of the characteristics of mobile user's big data and Hadoop system, an analysis model of mobile user's behavior pattern based on big data is constructed, it includes data acquisition module, data preprocessing module, user behavior analysis module, application of mobile user behavior model and data visualization module, and the function of each module is explained in detail. Recommendation algorithm based on user behavior analysis is discussed at last.

articleTitle: Optimization of Public Traffic Network Considering Demand Satisfaction Rate
publicationTitle: 2019 4th International Conference on Mechanical, Control and Computer Engineering (ICMCCE)
abstract: Optimization of public traffic line network is a significant way to address traffic issues in large and medium-sized cities. To address the issues of high operating cost and low convenience of transit line network, this paper builds an optimization model of public traffic line network aiming at the minimum operating cost, maximum operating income, minimum unsatisfied demand costs and minimum travel time of passengers, optimizes the direction of lines and departure frequency, and calls Gurobi through Python to address the model, and verifies the model through examples. Among them, the demand satisfaction rate is set as a decision variable to express the loss caused by the unsatisfied demands. The results turn out that adopting the proposed optimization model to optimize the public traffic line network can make the line operation scheme achieve better results in respect of passenger benefits and benefits of public traffic enterprises, which demonstrates that the model can be availably applied to the planning of public traffic line network.

articleTitle: China's Textile and Garment Industry Sharing Cloud Alliance Reverse Logistics
publicationTitle: 2019 4th International Conference on Mechanical, Control and Computer Engineering (ICMCCE)
abstract: The reverse logistics of China's textile and garment industry is characterized by shortage of raw materials, consumption of resources and low level of enterprise informatization. Based on the analysis of three reverse logistics operation modes, i.e. enterprise self-operation mode, manufacturer joint operation mode and outsourcing mode, this paper combines the concept of cloud with reverse logistics in textile and apparel industry for the first time, and proposes a shared cloud alliance reverse logistics operation mode suitable for textile and apparel industry. After quantitatively calculating the profits of enterprises, it can be seen that the optimized operation mode of shared cloud alliance is necessary for China's textile enterprises.

articleTitle: A Multi-level Access Control Scheme Based on Attribute Encryption for Big Data
publicationTitle: 2019 4th International Conference on Mechanical, Control and Computer Engineering (ICMCCE)
abstract: In order to meet the needs of flexibility and security in big data access, this paper first processes the access objects from folders, files and metadata respectively. Then, aiming at the security and efficiency problems in attribute encryption, this paper uses the processing strategy of public key encryption and private key decryption, and gives the attribute revocation. Finally, the experimental results show that the proposed scheme is feasible and effective.

articleTitle: Research on Reliability Method of Complex Mechanical Structure Based on Active Learning
publicationTitle: 2019 4th International Conference on Mechanical, Control and Computer Engineering (ICMCCE)
abstract: In order to solve the problem of implicit function and long simulation time in reliability analysis of complex mechanical structure, the reliability calculation method based on Kriging and Monte Carlo is adopted. In order to improve the accuracy of Kriging model quickly, the sample points which minimize the value of learning function are selected and substituted into the model. A learning stopping condition is proposed, which ensures the prediction accuracy of sample point symbols and significantly reduces the number of learning times. Finally, the numerical minimization problem and the artillery coordinator are taken as examples to verify the correctness of the proposed method.

articleTitle: Design of Laboratory Lighting Power Monitoring System Based on B/S
publicationTitle: 2019 4th International Conference on Mechanical, Control and Computer Engineering (ICMCCE)
abstract: The electrical energy consumed by university laboratories accounts for a large proportion of total electrical energy. How to effectively monitor the use of laboratory electrical energy has become extremely important. Taking the lighting circuit as an example, a targeted mobile-based lighting monitoring system was developed. The lighting monitoring system uses Visual Basic as the development language, MySQL as the background database, and OPC technology as the data transmission communication protocol and B/S architecture mode, which realizes the energy consumption of voltage, current and power in the laboratory lighting circuit on the mobile side. The results show that the designed laboratory lighting power monitoring system has real-time and simplicity, and the system runs smoothly during the testing process, showing that the system functions are more reasonable and perfect.

articleTitle: Survey of College Student Mobile Learning
publicationTitle: 2019 4th International Conference on Mechanical, Control and Computer Engineering (ICMCCE)
abstract: According to the questionnaire survey, mobile learning has become a learning method pursued by college students, but there are also problems such as unclear mobile learning objectives, unsatisfactory mobile learning resources, and insufficient self-discipline in mobile learning. Improve the research and development of mobile courseware, strengthen time management, enhance self-monitoring, set learning goals, and improve learning efficiency.

articleTitle: Study on Machining Quality of Knotter Frame of Square Baler
publicationTitle: 2019 4th International Conference on Mechanical, Control and Computer Engineering (ICMCCE)
abstract: Aiming at the knotter frame's feature of complicated structure, poor rigidity, high precision, inconvenience of fixture, easy to deform, difficult to ensure the machining quality. This paper makes preliminary research from three aspects of the frame machining process scheme, cutting parameters selection and the machining surface quality. Doing orthogonal test and processing related data, which about the cutting force, temperature field and stress field, coming from cutting simulation software AdvantEdg about cutting machining simulation by using the range analysis method, and then getting the basic rules of cutting machining affected by the cutting parameters, finally getting the optimal combination of cutting parameters of each process. This provides reference for the selection of the frame machining process scheme and the selection of cutting parameters of each process.

articleTitle: Laser Molten Pool Temperature Detecting Based on Recursive Estimation in 3D Printing
publicationTitle: 2019 4th International Conference on Mechanical, Control and Computer Engineering (ICMCCE)
abstract: Forming accuracy of the product is directly affected by the laser molten pool temperature. Since platform is in a high temperature environment, the pool temperature is difficult to detect. At present, the high-range infrared imager is expensive. It cannot be used widely. Therefore, in this paper, a detection method based on recursive estimation is proposed. In this method, the low-range infrared imager is used to detect the temperature of the laser molten poor, and the CNN is used to implement recursive estimation. The overrange detection of the temperature is achieved in this method. Through actual data verifying, the error of recursive estimation is satisfactory.

articleTitle: Improving Quality of Biomicroscope Using Six Sigma Method
publicationTitle: 2019 4th International Conference on Mechanical, Control and Computer Engineering (ICMCCE)
abstract: Because medical devices have strict regulations on product quality, effective quality management is particularly important in this field. In this paper, biomicroscope, a commonly used medical device, is studied. After the structure and process of the biomicroscope is analyzed, it is found that the eyepiece, as important parts in biomicroscope, has insufficient process capability. Then, Six Sigma method is applied to improve the quality of the eyepiece. It is found that pressure, temperature and time are the three key characteristics that affect the key quality of the eyepiece. Then, the significance of these three key characteristics are studied and the best values are obtained. Based on the best values, the defect rate is reduced, and the quality is improved.

articleTitle: Extending Component-Based Architecture to Design Embedded Real-Time System
publicationTitle: 2019 4th International Conference on Mechanical, Control and Computer Engineering (ICMCCE)
abstract: Extensions of Component-based architecture for developing embedded real-time systems are presented. Taking non-functional and quality properties of embedded real-time systems into account, the component-based architecture is extended by defining hardware and real-time component. To this end, a contract is defined as a set of constraint specifications supported by real-time mechanisms. Based on this real-time component, the real-time periodic, aperiodic and sporadic tasks and tasks communication can be expressed with components and communication between them. This work is benefit to reduce the complexity of system development and improve systematic real-time, safety and stability.

articleTitle: Influence of Vertically Misaligned Bearing on Shaft Whirling Vibration
publicationTitle: 2019 4th International Conference on Mechanical, Control and Computer Engineering (ICMCCE)
abstract: Bearing in rotor systems usually holds its own load which is different from others. For increasing their service life by load redistribution, their vertical locations are sometimes raised or lowered from the horizontal line. Finite element models of a four bearings shafting is studied and simulated in this paper to get the influence of whirling vibration under misaligned bearings. The result showed that bearings' misalignment has certain effects on both magnitude and frequency of whirling vibration.

articleTitle: A CNN Model for SMS Spam Detection
publicationTitle: 2019 4th International Conference on Mechanical, Control and Computer Engineering (ICMCCE)
abstract: A convolutional neural network (CNN) model is proposed for detection of Chinese short message service (SMS) spams. The Chinese Wikipedia corpus is used to train the word2vec model. On the basis of the training result, we conduct word segmentation on the sample short messages, convert the words into word vectors, and construct word-vector matrices of sentences as the input of the convolutional neural network. In the convolutional neural network, we first obtain a convolutional layer by performing convolution on the input layer, and then obtain a pooling layer by pooling (downsampling) the convolution layer; at last, we concatenate all pooling features on the pooling layer into a long vector which is used as the input of the Softmax classifier to detect SMS spams. This study also discusses the influence of hyperparameters on the CNN model and identifies the optimal combination of hyperparameters.

articleTitle: Progressive Kalman Filter and Its Application in Magnetic Target Tracking
publicationTitle: 2019 4th International Conference on Mechanical, Control and Computer Engineering (ICMCCE)
abstract: A nonlinear filter is proposed for magnetic dipole tracking. Firstly, the state-space model of magnetic dipole target is established. Secondly, the Bayesian discrete-time update is reformulated to a continuous progressive Bayesian problem, and the analytical solution is derived under linear Gaussian condition. Further the first-order Taylor expansion is applied to obtain the nonlinear approximate solution expression, thus deriving the progressive extended Kalman filter (PEKF). Simulation and real-world magnetic dipole tracking experiments are performed to demonstrate the effectiveness of PEKF. Both the simulation and measured target tracking test results suggest that the progressive extended Kalman filter has good precision and convergence, which can effectively suppress the performance degeneration and filter divergence caused by large initial error in magnetic target tracking, and the computational efficiency is equivalent to that of extended Kalman filter, which is suitable for practical magnetic dipole tracking application.

articleTitle: Lightweight Automotive Design Technology and Material Application Analysis
publicationTitle: 2019 4th International Conference on Mechanical, Control and Computer Engineering (ICMCCE)
abstract: Presently, several countries have established advanced technical indicators, which served as a core direction for the development of the local automobile industry. One of the foremost focuses of the industry is to explore methods to develop technologies which allow facilities to manufacture vehicles with low energy consumption, high-level security and can optimize the use of existing fuel resources. Given this situation, this paper will combine the lightweight material and light body structure technology theoretical system in the automobile lightweight technology to discuss and compare both domestic and foreign lightweight automobile design cases.

articleTitle: A Survey of Probabilistic Search Based on Bayesian Framework
publicationTitle: 2019 4th International Conference on Mechanical, Control and Computer Engineering (ICMCCE)
abstract: This paper reviews the development of probabilistic search and introduces the basic content of probabilistic search. Although there has been a lot of research work on search problem, there lacks a comprehensive survey on this topic, let alone the recently published works that focus on this field. This paper analyzes the probabilistic search decision-making framework developed in recent years and discusses the relevant search problems. Furthermore, a comprehensive applicable analysis for each kind of method is presented after considering its working mechanism and time complexity. Finally, the development trend of probabilistic search is pointed out.

articleTitle: Specific Person Recognition Based on Local Segmentation and Fusion
publicationTitle: 2019 4th International Conference on Mechanical, Control and Computer Engineering (ICMCCE)
abstract: With the development of video and image technology, it is of great practical value to recognize specific persons in television programs and photo albums. However, occlusion of body parts and changes in shooting position and distance are common in real scenes. In this work, we proposed a Specific Person Recognition based on Local Segmentation and Fusion method, called PR-LSF, which improved the reliability of person recognition in these environments. We represented the human body as an aggregate of multiple parts and apply local segmentation to train multiple convolutional neural network (CNN) classifiers. Each part classifier generated an identification decision confidence for each part. By training the SVM classifier, we weighted the decision confidence of all parts to make a comprehensive judgment. To verify the effectiveness of the proposed algorithm, we performed experiments with unoccluded and occluded test sets. The experimental results demonstrated that PR-LSF achieved higher recognition performance than algorithms using a single body part and were reliable even with partial occlusions, multiple scenes, and shooting changes.

articleTitle: Precise Robotic Grasp Algorithm for an Object with a Circular Feature
publicationTitle: 2019 4th International Conference on Mechanical, Control and Computer Engineering (ICMCCE)
abstract: In order to solve the precise robotic grasp problem, an industrial robot grasp workstation, aiming an object with a circular feature, was considered. To this end, a novel method, namely, POLAR-LINE2D has been proposed. This method combines the LINE-2D method, log-polar transform, and computer-aided design (CAD) technique together. It can precisely obtain the object's translation and rotation transformation. The first step in this method is to use the geometric feature to create a model of the object to be grasped and then use the LINE-2D method to obtain the translation transformation of the object in the input image. The second step is to apply the log-polar transformation to the input image. Finally, in the last step, the SVM multiple model selection and geometric LINE-2D methods are used to precisely determine the object's rotation angle.

articleTitle: Research on Video Surveillance Key Management Scheme Based on Identification Password
publicationTitle: 2019 4th International Conference on Mechanical, Control and Computer Engineering (ICMCCE)
abstract: Cryptography is the core and foundation of information security. Key management is an important means of cryptography. It guarantees key security throughout the lifecycle of key generation, distribution, storage, update, query, and destruction. In the video surveillance system, monitoring video storage, sharing, retrieval, etc. face many security threats. In this paper, a key management scheme is designed for video surveillance system based on Identity-Based Cryptograph and relevant national standards to enhance the security of video monitoring system. This paper analyzes the characteristics of various keys in the video surveillance system, studies the key management function, and proposes a scheme for the negotiation, generation, distribution, update, storage and query of keys. In this scheme, SM9 identification cryptography algorithm is used for authentication, SM4 symmetric cryptography algorithm is used for data encryption, and SM3 hash algorithm is used for data integrity verification, scheduling real-time video surveillance data in the system and Management to ensure the safety and reliability of the system.

articleTitle: SVM Based Identification Method for Hydrate Blockage in Natural Gas Pipelines
publicationTitle: 2019 4th International Conference on Mechanical, Control and Computer Engineering (ICMCCE)
abstract: Natural gas has been widely used around the world as a clean and environmental friendly energy. Natural gas hydrate blockage may form under a low temperature and high pressure condition, which will affect production process and even lead to severe accidents. In this paper, an identification method for gas hydrate blockage in pipeline based on acoustic excitation is presented, which can also work for pipeline leakage. An acoustic signal is transmitted into the pipeline by loudspeaker, then the reflected signals caused by hydrate blockage or leakage are acquired by a microphone near the loudspeaker. Empirical mode decomposition (EMD) method is employed to extract the eigenvectors of reflected signals, then a support vector machine (SVM) method is used to identify the types of reflected signals. Finally it is proved in the experiments that the proposed method can effective identify the hydrate blockage or leakage, and the identification accuracy rate is 97.5%.

articleTitle: Theoretical and Numerical Analysis of Fitness Bike Based on Ergonomics
publicationTitle: 2019 4th International Conference on Mechanical, Control and Computer Engineering (ICMCCE)
abstract: In order to meet people's exercise needs, the design program of this fitness bike is based on ergonomics. Its 3D model is established by SolidWorks software. The influence of each component on wrist point S is studied by the analytical analysis of the mechanism. Then, the optimal length of each component is determined. Finally, the static stress simulation analysis is carried out to ensure its safety performance.

articleTitle: A Method for Generating Functional Programming Template Based on Model Transformation
publicationTitle: 2019 4th International Conference on Mechanical, Control and Computer Engineering (ICMCCE)
abstract: Template meta-programming is a hot topic in programming languages, and functional programming is often employed in template meta-programming. ATS (Applied Type System) is a functional programming language includes formal specification and implementation, and it is good to be used for generating templates. Since ATS templates are difficult to be designed and lack generality, a method for generating ATS template based on model transformation is proposed in this paper. Firstly, an instance for generating Function from Datatype is given based on ATS Template Meta-programming; Secondly, an ATS meta-model includes the definitions of Datatype and Function is constructed by meta-modeling; Thirdly, the transformation from Datatype model to Function model is described in detail; Finally, an example of ATS Template Meta-programming based on model transformation is given to verify the effectiveness of this method. The experiments show that this method can implement ATS templates and increase the generality of ATS in template meta-programming.

articleTitle: Finite Element Simulation about Electric of Dry Ice Cleaning Tool for Substation Electrified Maintenance Robot
publicationTitle: 2019 4th International Conference on Mechanical, Control and Computer Engineering (ICMCCE)
abstract: When the robot is performing the cleaning operation of the charged with dry ice, it is necessary to ensure the safety of the working tools and equipment. The dry ice cleaning tool is mostly made of insulating materials, but due to strength and dry ice temperature, the spray guns of the dry ice cleaning tool is made of aluminum alloy. When the robot carries a dry ice cleaning tool into a high voltage environment, it would have an impact on the high voltage environment in the substation. The busbar in the substation is above the insulator, and the upper of the post insulator is connected to high voltage, so its voltage distribution in the field strength distribution has the greatest impact on the dry ice cleaning tool. The voltage distribution and field strength distribution of the pillar insulator and the dry ice cleaning tool are calculated by the finite element method in combination with the working conditions at the highest voltage position in the paper. The safe working distance of the dry ice cleaning tool is analyzed based on the numerical simulation results and the field strength under uneven air.

articleTitle: Research on the Characteristics of Shared Bicycle Travel Based on Time and Space Data
publicationTitle: 2019 4th International Conference on Mechanical, Control and Computer Engineering (ICMCCE)
abstract: Shared bicycle travel is a new type of green, economical and fashionable travel mode. It is essentially a new type of vehicle leasing business-bicycle leasing business; it accelerates man-car matching through LBS technology and becomes the general public to solve the last mile of important traffic tool. For Chengdu, with a resident population of 16.33 million, GDP of 1,543.277 billion RMB and an area of 14,335 square kilometers, millions of shared bicycle travel orders are generated daily. The number of active users per day is 1,318,140, and the number of active vehicles per day is 446,826. The vast majority of orders are generated between 7:00 and 9:00 in the morning peak and between 16:00 and 19:00 in the evening peak near the metro station and in the core urban areas.

articleTitle: Design and Numerical Simulation of Baffle Micromixer at the Bottom of Channel
publicationTitle: 2019 4th International Conference on Mechanical, Control and Computer Engineering (ICMCCE)
abstract: As a hot research spot emerging in recent years, lab-on-a-chip has broad application prospects in gene analysis, biological detection, chemical engineering and other fields. In order to improve the mixing efficiency of micro-mixer, this paper designs two kinds of single-side and double-side channel bottom blocking micro-mixer, and simulates and analyzes its flow field characteristics and mixing effect. The results showed that after the mixing distance of 2mm, the mixing effect of the two-sided blocking device was about 50% higher than that of the one-side blocking device, which provided a better idea and basis for the further study of similar micro-mixer in the back sequence.

articleTitle: Discussion about the Effect of Permanent Magnet Segmentation on Its Temperature Rising
publicationTitle: 2019 4th International Conference on Mechanical, Control and Computer Engineering (ICMCCE)
abstract: This paper analyzed the distribution of permanent magnet (PM) eddy current loss by theoretical method firstly. When the distribution of PM eddy current loss is accounted for thermal field calculation, it shows good agreement between the calculation result and test. Further, different segmentation methods in axial direction are analyzed which reveals some useful phenomenons that can guide PM temperature rising reducing when use PM axial direction segmentation methods.

Author Keywords: Distribution of PM eddy current loss

articleTitle: Trajectory Planning-Tracking Integration Control for 6R Free-Floating Space Robot Using Obstacle Avoidance Pseudo-Distance
publicationTitle: 2019 4th International Conference on Mechanical, Control and Computer Engineering (ICMCCE)
abstract: Focused on the obstacle avoidance planning and control problem of free-floating space robot (FFSR), a FFSR obstacle avoidance planning-tracking integrated control method is proposed. Based on the obstacle pseudo-distance technique, the FFSR inverse geometric model is utilized to solve the pseudo-distance estimation and the FFSR obstacle avoidance trajectory is obtained by solving the nonlinear optimization problem. Then Discrete State Dependent Riccati Equation (DSDRE) control method is used to combine global trajectory planning and local online obstacle avoidance. Finally, a simulation of 6R space robot model shows that the proposed method is valid and it can overcome the separation problem of trajectory planning and control in traditional FFSR control and improve the environmental adaptability of FFSR.

articleTitle: Tool Wear Volume and Residual Life Prediction Based on Extreme Learning Machine
publicationTitle: 2019 4th International Conference on Mechanical, Control and Computer Engineering (ICMCCE)
abstract: Since the tool wear state has a great influence on processing quality, an online monitoring method for tool wear state based on single-hidden layer feed-forward neural network (SLFN)-extreme learning machine (ELM) is proposed. According to the real-time working condition data of the milling tool, a variety of feature extraction methods including statistical analysis, fast Fourier transform and wavelet transform are used to extract 34 features. The 34 features are mixed features of time domain, frequency domain and time-frequency domain and they are sensitive to tool wear. The extracted features and wear volume are input into the extreme learning machine network framework for training to get the ELM model. Then put the test set features into the ELM model for prediction and evaluation, and the corresponding predicted tool wear volume and remaining number of passes are obtained. By comparing the prediction results of SVR and BPNN optimized by genetic algorithm, it is found that ELM has the advantages of fast learning speed, high prediction accuracy and strong generalization ability, and can realize online monitoring of tool wear state.

articleTitle: Design of a Wind Speed Sensor Based on MEMS
publicationTitle: 2019 4th International Conference on Mechanical, Control and Computer Engineering (ICMCCE)
abstract: This paper presents the design, fabrication and test results of a 2D hot-air speed sensor based on the micro-electro-mechanical technology. The sensor uses constant power operation mode and uses the method of thermal temperature difference to measure the wind speed and direction. The sensor uses the micro-electro-mechanical peeling technology to fabricate both heating resistance and temperature-measuring resistance on glass substrates. Thermal isolation and high sensitivity are achieved by depending on the processing technology.

articleTitle: Analysis of the Application of Artificial Intelligence in Electronic Information Security Under the Background of Internet
publicationTitle: 2019 4th International Conference on Mechanical, Control and Computer Engineering (ICMCCE)
abstract: Along with the continuous development of the economy and society, the Internet background has become the potential background of the development of the times, and the parallel issue of electronic information security has become a major issue that people are increasingly concerned about. Based on this, this paper first briefly introduces the concept and basic characteristics of artificial intelligence, and then discusses the application of artificial intelligence in electronic information security from the current social electronic information security situation, in order to provide reference for the exchange of relevant people.

articleTitle: Study on Modulation Strategies for Hybrid 15-Level Converter Based Electric Vehicle Energy Storage
publicationTitle: 2019 4th International Conference on Mechanical, Control and Computer Engineering (ICMCCE)
abstract: The multi-level cascade converter is composed of H-bridge module in series. An improved 15-level hybrid cascade converter based on DC energy storage of electric vehicle can be obtained by changing the ratio of DC energy storage to supply voltage from 1:1:1 to 4:2:1 of the traditional cascaded 7-level converter cascaded by three H-bridge modules. In this paper, the modulation strategy of the 15 level hybrid cascade converter is studied, and a new algorithm for the switching angle of the multilevel converter powered by DC energy storage device for electric vehicle is proposed. Based on Saber simulation software, three different modulation strategies, stepped-wave modulation, PWM and partial PWM, are applied to verify and compare. Finally, the simulation results of total harmonic distortion, low-order harmonic component and switching loss of the converter based on the output voltage without any filter are compared, and the related modulation strategies are discussed.

articleTitle: Research on TDMA Burst Carrier Synchronization Based on LEO Satellite
publicationTitle: 2019 4th International Conference on Mechanical, Control and Computer Engineering (ICMCCE)
abstract: The high-speed motion of satellites will bring larger doppler frequency shift in LEO satellite communication system. This will seriously affect carrier synchronization of short burst signal in TDMA systems. In this paper, a carrier synchronization scheme based on doppler frequency shift pre-compensation and an improved method for estimating frequency offset is proposed. This scheme improves carrier synchronization performance by compensating Doppler frequency shift and preprocessing signal. The simulation results show that the scheme is feasible and effective in low SNR.

articleTitle: Research on Rainstorm Weather Detection Method Based on Weighted Density Adaptive A-DBSCAN Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2019 4th International Conference on Mechanical, Control and Computer Engineering (ICMCCE)
abstract: Accurate detection of regional extreme weather is a research hotspot. Therefore, based on the real-time image of the camera, this paper proposes a new method for real-time detection of rainstorm weather based on the camera image by combining Laplacian operator and gaussian filter to calculate the image feature value (LOG value), and then establish the regression model of the LOG value and the recorded rainfall data. In addition, aiming at the characteristics of high noise in images collected by cameras, this paper proposes an adaptive method of A-DBSCAN denoising based on weighted density. The experiment in this paper proves that A-DBSCAN method can greatly improve the accuracy of real-time detection of rainstorm information from camera images.

articleTitle: Research on Fault Dynamic Response Analysis Method of Complex System Based on Virtual Diagnostic Environment
publicationTitle: 2019 4th International Conference on Mechanical, Control and Computer Engineering (ICMCCE)
abstract: This paper establishes the dynamic equation of typical system based on the digital prototype, and acts the virtual dynamic loading spectrum on the digital prototype, and constructs the virtual diagnostic environment, and replaces the actual equipment in the virtual environment, and reappears its kinematics and dynamics state in the complex operating conditions, and analyses the geometric elements and dynamics response during the movement. State response is used to predict the trends of individual characteristic parameters. In engineering practice, the fault state of the equipment will be reflected in the characteristic parameters of the model. In this paper, a fault prediction simulation scheme based on virtual diagnosis environment is established, and three key components are tracked and simulated. The kinematics and dynamics state characteristic simulation based on digital prototype is introduced into the fault prediction of mechanical system. In the process, the development trend and maximum threshold of equipment fault characteristic parameters are simulated numerically. This fault pattern recognition method breaks through the limitation of on-line monitoring in previous studies.
