It can not only ensure the safety of equipment operation, but also effectively reduce pollution and make full use of diagnostic resources. It also has great social and economic benefits for improving the monitoring ability of equipment operation quality.

articleTitle: Research on Improving RBF Decoupling Control Model of Film Thickness Control Based on PSO
publicationTitle: 2019 4th International Conference on Mechanical, Control and Computer Engineering (ICMCCE)
abstract: The BOPP film thickness control system is a nonlinear and complex multivariable coupling system. The three-channel transfer function matrix model is obtained by analyzing the process, The existing decoupling algorithm has a good effect in the film thickness control system, but cannot completely eliminate the system coupling effect, and the system robustness still needs to be improved. So the RBF model is used to decouple the system and the RBFD algorithm is designed. Aiming at the long training process situation of RBF decoupling algorithm, fast self-learning, attaching differential term and particle swarm optimization (PSO) are used to optimize the RBF model to improve the anti-interference ability and response speed of the system, so as to design the ASRBFD decoupling algorithm and realize the complete dynamic decoupling control. The experiment results show that the ASRBFD decoupling method designed in this paper has strong anti-interference ability, high RBF model training efficiency and excellent decoupling performance.

articleTitle: Analysis of Rules of Antler Glue Use Based on Association Rules
publicationTitle: 2019 4th International Conference on Mechanical, Control and Computer Engineering (ICMCCE)
abstract: Objective: Based on literature mining and analysis, the compatibility rule of antler gum was discussed. Methods: The theme of "antler gum" is January 1959-May 1959. In the China Knowledge Network database advanced search interface to search, including 129 documents in line with the standard. And use Excel 2013, SPSS Modeler 14.1, SPSS Statistics 19.0 statistical software as a tool to analyze the Chinese medicine prescriptions included in the standard. Results: According to the frequency analysis, among the 129 first formulae included in the standard, the single Chinese medicine Antler glue (129 times, 100.0%), Rehmannia rehmannii (74 times, 57.4%), Angelica (65 times, 50.4%) and Astragalus (51 times, 39.5%) had the highest frequency. In the statistical analysis of the medicinal properties of 13 traditional Chinese medicines (more than 30), Gan (11 times, 84.6%), Xin (3 times, 23.1%) and Bitter (3 times, 23.1%) were the most common. Meridian of kidney (9 times, 69.2%), liver (9 times, 69.2%) and spleen (8 times, 61.5%) were the most common. There are 8 kinds of common diseases in TCM, most of which are nephropathy. Nine combinations with the highest correlation intensity were obtained in association rule analysis. Conclusion: The application of modern information technology and the in-depth analysis and integration of TCM clinical data and big data can facilitate the exploration of potential compatibility rules of TCM, and ultimately feed back to the clinic, providing a basis for the guidance of clinical medication and the research and development of new prescriptions.

articleTitle: Design of Civil UAV Counter System Based on BDS
publicationTitle: 2019 4th International Conference on Mechanical, Control and Computer Engineering (ICMCCE)
abstract: In order to effectively control the phenomenon of "Unruly Flying" about Unmanned Aerial Vehicle (UAV), early warning interference measures should be taken to protect the privacy of people by researching on the civil UVA counter system. Therefore, the paper discusses the research on the civil UVA counter system. The system is designed to perform two functions: early warning and delayed interference. The general algorithm of the BeiDou satellite positioning distance is used to verify the early warning function. The delay algorithm the BeiDou signal forwards demonstrates the feasibility of the function for delayed interference. The results show that the effect of counter-production on civil UAV can be achieved by defining the early warning and delay results.

articleTitle: Development of a Lifting Medical Care Bed
publicationTitle: 2019 4th International Conference on Mechanical, Control and Computer Engineering (ICMCCE)
abstract: In order to reduce the work intensity of the nursing staff and improve the patient's comfort, based on the analysis of the defects of the traditional medical care bed, according to the relevant quality control standard, a novel lifting medical care bed was developed. The detailed structural function size and analysis process of the device are given. Through the finite element analysis and optimization, a reasonable structural form is designed. Through the design and development of the lateral lifting system, the manipulation of the medical bed is more humanized.

articleTitle: Physical Training Evaluation Method for College Students Based on Analytic Hierarchy Process
publicationTitle: 2019 4th International Conference on Mechanical, Control and Computer Engineering (ICMCCE)
abstract: This study introduces a physical training evaluation method based on the analytic hierarchy process to solve the difficulty of quantifying the evaluation of the physical training of college students. First, this method establishes an evaluation index system and constructs the corresponding evaluation index judgement matrix. Second, it normalises and calculates the index combination weight for constructing the basic evaluation model. Finally, this evaluation model is comprehensively utilised to evaluate the physical training of college students. The results denote that the method proposed in this study can effectively evaluate the physical training of college students. When compared with the traditional assessment method, the proposed method can better reflect the real physical condition and highlight the physical characteristics of the college students as well as conduct targeted training for the college students.

articleTitle: Effectiveness Evaluation of Public Security Face Recognition Systems Based on Improved Unascertained C-Means
publicationTitle: 2019 4th International Conference on Mechanical, Control and Computer Engineering (ICMCCE)
abstract: In order to evaluate and improve the effectiveness of the public security face recognition systems reasonably and scientifically in real scenes, we create an effectiveness evaluation index system and the improved Unascertained C-means model. The data of indicators are obtained through measuring practical application systems of five public security bureaus. Then we carry out data statistics and pretreatment. The improved Unascertained C-means algorithm is realized by programming in MATLAB. After inputting the data into the model, we obtain the evaluation results. By comparing the real achievements of each system during the evaluation cycle, we verify the consistency between the evaluation results and realities. On the basis of the comparative analysis of the evaluation results, we identify the weaknesses of a system, and put forward some optimization strategies of the system effectiveness. In the paper, we synthetically apply various methods, such as qualitative analysis, quantitative analysis, theoretical analysis and experimental analysis, to study the uncertainty problem of the effectiveness evaluation of the public security face recognition systems. The evaluation process is objective and impartial, the results are valid and reasonable, and the strategies are targeted and operable. This paper is of certain theoretical significance to the research on effectiveness evaluation, and it is of certain practical significance to effectiveness improvement of the practical application systems.

articleTitle: Manifold Learning Based on Sparse Neighbourhood Classification
publicationTitle: 2019 4th International Conference on Mechanical, Control and Computer Engineering (ICMCCE)
abstract: Manifold learning and its various algorithms have attracted more and more attention in recent years. Locally linear embedding (LLE) algorithm, as a classical nonlinear dimensionality reduction algorithm, has been widely used in many technical fields, such as image classification and object recognition. This paper proposes an improved algorithm based on LLE algorithm-Sparse LLE, which applies a new method of classification in the process of finding K-nearest neighbours with original LLE algorithm. According to the experiment results, the new algorithm can not only guarantee the effect of dimensionality reduction, but also greatly reduce the processing time of the dimensionality reduction of datasets.

articleTitle: Parametric Design of Small Rail Stacker Based on Dimension Drive
publicationTitle: 2019 4th International Conference on Mechanical, Control and Computer Engineering (ICMCCE)
abstract: There are some problems, such as: repetitive design and inefficiency in traditional design method of small rail stacker, as well as the excessive selection of parameters and the tedious use process of existing parametric design system and so on. In light of this situation, the second development of SolidWorks is carried out, after deeply studied and analyzed the SolidWorks' development tools and interface technology. Using C# programming language and SolidWorks interface technology, the parametric design system of small rail stacker based on dimension-driven is designed. The parametric design of stacker is realized by the parametric design table method of SolidWorks series parts. The system not only enormously curtails the product design period, improves the work efficiency, but also enormously simplifies the user's use process.

articleTitle: Workspace Boundary Search Algorithm for Parallel Mechanism Based on Two-Dimensional Cell
publicationTitle: 2019 4th International Conference on Mechanical, Control and Computer Engineering (ICMCCE)
abstract: By understanding the neighborhood types of cellular automata, a workspace boundary search algorithm for parallel mechanisms based on two-dimensional cells is proposed to describe the process of boundary point search. Taking 3RPR planar parallel mechanism as an example, the inverse kinematics equation is established to solve the kinematics inverse solution of the mechanism, and the inverse solution is used as the constraint condition to realize the inverse kinematics of the mechanism by cell search method. At last, three neighborhoods are used to solve the 3RPR workspace. The results show that all three neighborhoods can solve the workspace. Among them, the extended Moore neighborhood can solve the boundary points accurately and clearly.

articleTitle: Method and Research on Automatic Generation and Fluency Discrimination of Movie Word Sequence Based on NNLM
publicationTitle: 2019 4th International Conference on Mechanical, Control and Computer Engineering (ICMCCE)
abstract: In the context of massive information on the Internet, how to automatically generate word sequence statements based on words and make them compliant is crucial. In this paper, the neural network language model (NNLM) is used to judge the automatically generated Chinese movie title sentence, and the highest probability value in the data set is obtained, that is, the top 10 statements with the best fluency. At the same time, the N-Gram algorithm is used for screening, and the screening results are compared with the results of NNLM. After professional evaluation and analysis, the discriminant result of NNLM algorithm is better. However, in the real-time discriminating scene, the computational complexity of the NNLM algorithm is much larger than that of the N-Gram algorithm, so it needs to be considered after comprehensive consideration.

articleTitle: Study on Terrain Heterogeneity and Its Influence in "Sanjiangyuan" Area
publicationTitle: 2019 4th International Conference on Mechanical, Control and Computer Engineering (ICMCCE)
abstract: Based on the DEM grid image of "sanjiangyuan" region and the temperature data of 16 meteorological stations from 1951 to 2010, this paper calculated and processed the topographic fluctuation, elevation standard deviation and surface roughness indexes representing topographic heterogeneity, and analyzed the impact of topographic heterogeneity on local climate and other aspects. The results show that the overall terrain elevation of "sanjiangyuan" region is high, the surface fluctuation is large, and the south and southeast of the region are the places with the most drastic topographic changes, and the absolute value of topographic fluctuation, elevation standard deviation and surface roughness are all large. In the central and western regions, the terrain changes little, the relief degree is small, the elevation standard deviation and the surface roughness are also small. In the whole study area, the climate in the area with similar latitude was significantly affected by terrain heterogeneity. The climate in the area with large terrain heterogeneity was correspondingly characterized by warmer and wetter, more precipitation and higher temperature.

articleTitle: Graph-Based Priority-Aware MAC Protocol for Wireless Body Area Networks
publicationTitle: 2019 4th International Conference on Mechanical, Control and Computer Engineering (ICMCCE)
abstract: Wireless Body Area Networks (WBANs) have received considerable attention in recent years. Several sensors are placed in and around the human body to gather health information. One of the main challenges in WBANs is the design of a Medium Access Control (MAC) protocol that plays a vital role for the efficient functionality. In this paper we propose a graph-based priority-aware MAC protocol for WBANs. The network cluster-tree topology is modeled as an interference graph. Using graph coloring scheme, the contention-free time slots are assigned to the sensor nodes. Data priority is considered in the procedure of time slot reallocation. Simulation results show that the scheme improves the network performance.

articleTitle: Impermeable Layer Leakage Detection using a Transmission Line Model
publicationTitle: 2019 4th International Conference on Mechanical, Control and Computer Engineering (ICMCCE)
abstract: This paper presents a circuit location system that detects high-density polyethylene (HDPE) leakage for landfills. The boundary electrical parameters in the non-uniform transmission lines model are used to derive the ranging equation, the power frequency is varied from 5 to 30 MHz, and the terminal load is varied from 1 to 10 KΩ to verify the model resolution. An out-of-synchronization error analysis is performed for the double-end electrical parameters. Finally, the error of the experimental precision is determined using the quasi-Newton algorithm and the conjugate gradient algorithm. The experimental results show that based on synchronous sampling and the conjugate gradient algorithm, when the power frequency ranges from 15 to 20 MHz and the terminal load ranges from 5 to 6 KΩ, the terminal sampling reaches a maximum numerical value that varies, and the positioning results are more accurate.

articleTitle: Research on Power Generation Performance of Stacked Thermoelectric Power Generation Module
publicationTitle: 2019 4th International Conference on Mechanical, Control and Computer Engineering (ICMCCE)
abstract: At present, the superior value coefficient of thermoelectric materials is low, which seriously affects the performance of temperature difference power generation. In the face of no major breakthrough in materials, only by increasing the temperature difference to improve power generation efficiency, this paper proposes a stacked temperature difference power generation structure to improve the temperature difference power generation performance. The ANSYS finite element simulation software is used to simulate the power generation performance of the two-layer temperature difference power generation structure at different temperatures. The feasibility of the stacked temperature difference power generation structure is verified. It is found that the double-layer temperature difference power generation structure makes full use of the hot end temperature and has good thermal conductivity. Compared with the traditional thermoelectric power generation structure, the output power of the two-layer thermoelectric power generation structure is increased by 92.36% and the power generation efficiency is increased by 54.48%, which is of great significance for further study of the thermoelectric power generation structure.

articleTitle: Attributed Community Search with Forbidden Nodes
publicationTitle: 2019 4th International Conference on Mechanical, Control and Computer Engineering (ICMCCE)
abstract: The study of community search problems in large graphs has attracted more and more attention: given a query node q, it is required to return communities containing the query node. In recent years, some researchers have considered keyword information to make the attributed community search is gradually emerging, which is widely used in social network marketing and setting up of social events. However, some problems require that the query communities cannot contain certain forbidden nodes, which has not received any attention in previous work. Based on this, this paper proposes undirected attributed community search with forbidden nodes problem (FATQ), which not only avoids forbidden nodes from existing in the query communities, but also guarantees the structure cohesiveness of the query communities and the keyword cohesiveness of the communities. Finally, this paper proposes two different search algorithms for FATQ problem and evaluates our algorithms on multiple datasets. The results show that correctness and effectiveness of the proposed methods.

articleTitle: Study on Wind Consumption in Regenerative Electric Heating Considering Thermal Comfort of Users
publicationTitle: 2019 4th International Conference on Mechanical, Control and Computer Engineering (ICMCCE)
abstract: In order to solve the problem of inadequate wind power consumption in northern China during winter heating period, this paper considers the thermal comfort of users, and establishes a multi-objective function based on the minimum coal consumption of the system and the optimum heating comfort of users. Then, based on the constraints of system operation, unit operation, thermal comfort of users and power balance, an optimal model of regenerative electric heating considering user thermal comfort is established. The results show that the wind power consumption considering the thermal comfort of users is stronger than that without considering the thermal comfort of users. The abandoned wind power decreases by 35.29%, due to the power of thermal power units decreases, the cost of coal consumption decreases by 2.75%. The economic effect is remarkable.

articleTitle: Design and Application of Intelligent Large Data Analysis System for Space Target Detection and Recognition
publicationTitle: 2019 4th International Conference on Mechanical, Control and Computer Engineering (ICMCCE)
abstract: Aiming at the low efficiency of data management, inadequate data analysis and processing ability, incomplete utilization of observation data and low contribution to the improvement of system service performance in the monitoring station(Abbreviated as monitoring station) of space target detection and recognition test system, Hadoop and other big data technology are used to develop a platform with functions of data storage management, analysis and mining, quality evaluation, etc. The active controlled early warning system of system equipment performance status is established, which solves the difficult problem of storage and management of massive observation data. At the same time, using the results of large data analysis, mining and exploring the correlation and influence rules of monitoring data, to provide reliable support for improving the service performance of space target monitoring system.

articleTitle: Calculation of Total Longitudinal Bending Stress of Damaged Hull Based on a Modified Equivalent Beam Method
publicationTitle: 2019 4th International Conference on Mechanical, Control and Computer Engineering (ICMCCE)
abstract: This paper proposes a modified equivalent straight beam method to calculate the total longitudinal strength of a damaged hull. Firstly, the average stress is obtained by the method of original equivalent beam, and then the stress concentration coefficient of sharp corner rectangular fracture is analysed. The stress concentration coefficient of the fracture is divided into the plate stress concentration coefficient and stiffeners coefficient, and a simplified algorithm is put forward according to their progressive law. In addition, considering the nonlinearity of the material, the correction formula of elastic stress concentration coefficient is fitted. Finally, the calculation results based on modified equivalent beam methods make the damage hull strength check more realistic and reliable.

articleTitle: The Mode and Definition of the Content Variation Angle by Yang Dongfang
publicationTitle: 2019 4th International Conference on Mechanical, Control and Computer Engineering (ICMCCE)
abstract: This paper studies the content change of Pb in the surface and bottom water of Jiaozhou Bay and its settlement process according to the investigation materials in May, August and October in the year 1991. The author comes up with the definition and mode of Yang Dongfang content variation angle. Through the changing process of the content variation angle, this study determines the changing degree to which the substance content varies over time, and gives the standard of changing degree. Classifying the Yang Dongfang content variation angle in the interval [-90°,90°] to many intervals [-90°,-60°,-45°,-30°, 0°,30°,45°,60°,90°], this study elaborates the standard of changing degree to which the substance content changing over time, and quantitatively reveals the horizontal changing process of substance content in the surface and bottom layers and vertical changing process between surface and bottom layers. Calculating the result based on the definition and mode of Yang Dongfang content variation angle, the author gets the conclusion that the Yang Dongfang content variation angle is 79.15°in the surface water from May to August, and -83.96°from August to October. In the bottom water, it is 81.68°from May to August and -84.25°from August to October. According to the scale of temporal and spatial variation, human activity has directly increased the Pb content in surface layer to a higher degree, and may also radically decrease the Pb content to a lower level. Furthermore, the Pb content in the bottom and surface layers varies the same after getting through the water body. As the changing over time, the decrease of Pb content in surface and bottom water body is consistent under the effects of gravity and water stream. Therefore, human beings must keep a clean marine environment and reduce the emission of Pb content as far as possible.

articleTitle: Water Circulation Control System of Dynamic Flow Detection Device Based on PID
publicationTitle: 2019 4th International Conference on Mechanical, Control and Computer Engineering (ICMCCE)
abstract: The precision of the dynamic flow detection device produced in China cannot meet the demand of pharmaceutical, food and beverage industries. In order to improve the accuracy of the dynamic flow detection device, a PID based water circulation control system is designed in this paper to improve the accuracy of the water circulation system in the dynamic flow detection device. Experimental results show that the control system can effectively improve the stability of the water circulation system.

articleTitle: Design and Test of Single-Pick Single-off Tooth-Type Residual Film Picker
publicationTitle: 2019 4th International Conference on Mechanical, Control and Computer Engineering (ICMCCE)
abstract: For the wheel-toothed residual film picker on the more serious broken film pick-up effect is not ideal, designed a single-pick Single-off tooth-type residual film picker. The single-pick single-pick single-type tooth-type residual film picker, it is composed of single-pick single-off pick-up machine shell device, fork-type residual film picking roller mechanism and "twisted" type flexible defilming roller mechanism, The test results show that the single-pick wheel tooth-type residual film picker efficiency is 81%, meeting the agronomic requirements of the residual film pick-up, while its structure is simple, the weight is light, the required traction is small, the reliability is high, the economy is good, provides theoretical support for the design of the wheel tooth-type residual film picker.

articleTitle: Target Positioning and Error Analysis Based on Cooperative Illumination
publicationTitle: 2019 4th International Conference on Mechanical, Control and Computer Engineering (ICMCCE)
abstract: Aiming at the target location problem under cooperative illumination conditions, a T/R-R system model with two platforms is established to derive the positioning equation. According to the error distribution law of different scenes, a method of error complementary combination is proposed for target localization. Finally, the Monte-Carlo method is used for numerical simulation experiments. The simulation results show that the coordinate error of subset 10 is the least when solving alone. Compared with the error of observation subset 10, the coordinate error of the joint solution of error complementarity is greatly reduced. The coordinate error of the target position of observation subset 5 and observation subset 8 for the joint solution of error complementarity is the smallest and closer to the real value. In the actual process of solving the target location, observation subset 5 and observation subset 8 are selected first when the measured data are sufficient to conduct error complementary joint processing to solve the target location. The simulation results provided theoretical basis for reasonably selecting positioning methods to achieve high-precision positioning in different battlefield environments.

articleTitle: Design of Magnetic Force Actuator for 1100kV High Speed Bypass Switch
publicationTitle: 2019 4th International Conference on Mechanical, Control and Computer Engineering (ICMCCE)
abstract: The magnetic force actuator for the 1100kV high-speed bypass switch is designed. Firstly, the basic structure of the bypass switch is introduced. Combined with the requirements of the bypass switch on the operating parameters, the simulation model of the magnetic force actuator is established. The effects of capacitor parameters and coil parameters on the motion characteristics are simulated and analyzed. Through parameter optimization, the actuator that meets the requirements is finally obtained. The closing speed can reach 3.5 m/s. The closing time is less than 25 ms. The long travel and high speed of the actuator are realized. This paper lays the foundation for the application of magnetic force actuator to higher voltage levels.

articleTitle: Mechatronics Teaching and Training Device Based on Stereo Garage
publicationTitle: 2019 4th International Conference on Mechanical, Control and Computer Engineering (ICMCCE)
abstract: This paper introduces a typical mechatronics integrated training device. The device is composed of an automated stereo garage, including mechanical system, motor drive system and automatic control system. It is suitable for mechanical and electronic engineering, mechanical engineering and automation, automation and other specialties, which is related teaching and comprehensive training. The device is specially designed for teaching and training purposes on the basis of the real electromechanical integration products, and strengthens the comprehensive application ability of electromechanical system engineering technology such as electromechanical system design, processing, manufacturing, installation and debugging.

articleTitle: Intelligent Traffic Signal Control Based on Multiple Agents
publicationTitle: 2019 4th International Conference on Mechanical, Control and Computer Engineering (ICMCCE)
abstract: At present, with the rapid development of social economy, people's living standards have been gradually improved, and the number of urban motor vehicles has been increasing, resulting in increasingly prominent traffic problems, and traffic congestion has become an urgent problem to be solved. Wireless sensor network (WSN), as a new information acquisition and processing technology, has the characteristics of unrestricted environment, self-organization and distribution in traffic signal control system. However, due to the limitation of single sensor node itself, the multi-agent theory can be used as an effective method to describe and analyze. Based on this, this paper introduces the multi-agent technology to study the intelligent traffic signal control in the multi-agent environment, focusing on the single intersection signal control method and multi-intersection signal coordination control method.

articleTitle: Benefit Analysis of Synchronous Operation of Regenerative Electric Heating and Wind Power
publicationTitle: 2019 4th International Conference on Mechanical, Control and Computer Engineering (ICMCCE)
abstract: Wind energy is a renewable and energy-rich clean energy source, which is of great significance for energy conservation and emission reduction. However, the uncertainty of wind power makes the wind aggravation. This paper focuses on the principle of cooperative operation mechanism of regenerative electric heating and wind power generation and constructs a cooperative operation model considering relevant constraints. The economics of the model are evaluated by establishing an economic evaluation system. Finally, case studies show that the coordinated operation of wind energy and regenerative electric heating improves the wind power's ability to absorb and the system's peaking ability, effectively alleviating the wind abandonment phenomenon. At the same time, it has improved economics and improved the environment. Contributed to China's resource conservation and environmental protection.

articleTitle: Dynamic Analysis of Overflow Decompression Drilling Circuit of Coalbed Methane Drilling Rig
publicationTitle: 2019 4th International Conference on Mechanical, Control and Computer Engineering (ICMCCE)
abstract: The pressure-relief drilling circuit of CBM drilling rig is studied, and the pressure-flow characteristics of relief valve during the process of relief drilling are analyzed. Combining with the load characteristics of ZMK5530TZJ60 drilling rig, the selection of relief valve and the prevention of parameter matching are put forward. Using AMEsim software dynamic simulation system, pressure and flow characteristics of pressure relief drilling loop are obtained. At the same time, parameter matching is optimized by software simulation. It can be used for reference for matching and optimizing parameters of decompression drilling circuit of CBM drilling rig.

articleTitle: Design and Implementation of Distributed Temperature Monitoring System Based on Fiber Optic Temperature Sensor
publicationTitle: 2019 4th International Conference on Mechanical, Control and Computer Engineering (ICMCCE)
abstract: In order to realize the spacecraft temperature measurement in space simulation space vacuum heat environment, real-time monitoring of spacecraft structure temperature and spacecraft health status diagnosis, a distributed temperature monitoring system based on fiber temperature sensor is designed. Firstly, the distributed optical fiber temperature monitoring hardware system was built by using the characteristics of the fiber temperature sensor. Secondly, through the modular design, the LabVIEW was used to read the center wavelength value of the fiber grating connected to the fiber grating demodulator in real time. The decoupling algorithm of stress realizes the functions of temperature data acquisition, display and storage. Finally, the distributed temperature monitoring system is tested in high and low temperature under vacuum low temperature environment, and its repeatability is verified. The system test shows that the monitoring system can measure the temperature of the spacecraft structural components in a vacuum low temperature environment, and the system has good repeatability through three tests.

articleTitle: Analysis on Power Emergency System' Surveillance Structure with Ubiquitous-Networked Intelligent Techniques
publicationTitle: 2019 4th International Conference on Mechanical, Control and Computer Engineering (ICMCCE)
abstract: Data Sources are relatively independent in existing IOT applications. Based on restructure of the present surveillance structure, with Ubiquitous-Networked Intelligent techniques, the paper implements a power emergency measuring structure with ubiquitous networked system with various data sources. Survey on power emergency system shows that security system has positive impact on system's surveillance structure, and the result enlargs the concept and scale of it's application and industry.

articleTitle: Influence of Supporting Stiffness on Critical Speeds of a Power Turbine Rotor System
publicationTitle: 2019 4th International Conference on Mechanical, Control and Computer Engineering (ICMCCE)
abstract: In this paper, the variation of critical speed with the supporting stiffness of a power turbine analogue rotor system is studied. The finite element method (FEM) is used to establish the model of the power turbine analogue rotor system and the modal analysis is carried out to reveal the relationship between the first three critical speeds and the supporting stiffness. The results indicate that the supporting stiffness shows a significant effect on the critical speeds of the power turbine rotor system.

articleTitle: Research on Control Defects Method of Pits and Bulges in Stamping Surface of Truck Roof
publicationTitle: 2019 4th International Conference on Mechanical, Control and Computer Engineering (ICMCCE)
abstract: Pits and bulges are one of the common quality defects of stamping parts. Because the reintegration will increase the cost of the whole vehicle, it is necessary to use reasonable methods to solve and prevent it. This paper analyzes and introduces the causes of pits and bulges defects in the various surface defects of truck roof in the stamping production process, describes the detection methods of pits and bulges defects, and discusses the production in stamping production. Measures to prevent pits and bulges defects. It has the same reference value for surface defect control of various body stampings.

articleTitle: Based on the Cloud Data Center Optical Switching Scheduling and Routing Algorithm Research and Practice
publicationTitle: 2019 4th International Conference on Mechanical, Control and Computer Engineering (ICMCCE)
abstract: The trend of diversification, convenience and scale development of cloud services brings new challenges to the optimization of network performance of data centers. This paper around the exchange of data center network performance optimization scheduling and routing algorithm design problems put forward two based on the Input Queue (IQ: Input Queue) optical switching scheduling algorithm of SDF (Stringent Delay First) and m - SDF (m - order Stringent Delay First). Study two data center network models: multiple independent data center network mi-dcn (Multiple Independent DCN) and Integrated Distributed DCN. The concept of Software Defined Network (SDN) is introduced into the data center, and the transmission routing algorithm is designed to realize load balancing of data center resources.

articleTitle: Research on Motion Control Technology of Six Degree of Freedom Industrial Robot
publicationTitle: 2019 4th International Conference on Mechanical, Control and Computer Engineering (ICMCCE)
abstract: In the increasingly modern field of industrial manufacturing, there is a growing demand for industrial robots. Among them, trajectory planning and trajectory tracking control algorithm of industrial robots are the core and content of industrial robots' research. The research in this field can provide technical support for industrial robots to run smoothly and improve work efficiency. In order to verify the effectiveness of the proposed trajectory tracking control method for six-DOF industrial robots, simulation experiments are carried out on the simulation platform. The simulation results show that the proposed trajectory tracking control algorithm is effective and achieves the desired goal.

articleTitle: Food Simulation on the Basis of Data Collection Research
publicationTitle: 2019 4th International Conference on Mechanical, Control and Computer Engineering (ICMCCE)
abstract: Dishes is regarded the final presentation form of cooking. Sensor and image technology are used to collect and manage data in the external form of dishes, mainly involving style, color, and changes in the process of cooking. The artificial (taste) evaluation verification of dishes is also established to obtain a complete form of description and actual evaluation of food and dishes, thereby forming data simulation of varied cooking technology and food, and controlling the quality of finished food dishes by computer to achieve the whole process of cooking process simulation and design.

articleTitle: Distributed Signal Detection with Information Sharing Among Local Sensors
publicationTitle: 2019 4th International Conference on Mechanical, Control and Computer Engineering (ICMCCE)
abstract: The shared nature of wireless channel motivates the study of distributed detection scheme with information sharing among local sensors. The optimal form of local decision rule of binary distributed detection of a known signal is considered, where some sensors broadcast their local decisions to the other sensors, which combine their observations with the information broadcasted by the other sensors to make their local decisions. We show that, in this case, the optimal form of local processing under the Bayesian criterion is a modification to the canonical likelihood ratio test (LRT) and the optimality of LRT quantization do not hold true for sensors listening to another sensor's transmission. Also, a design procedure using the obtained results is developed. Numerical results illustrated the effectiveness of the result in obtaining optimal decision parameters for local sensors.

articleTitle: Research on Layout Planning of Microwave Relay Communication Equipment in Canyon Terrain
publicationTitle: 2019 4th International Conference on Mechanical, Control and Computer Engineering (ICMCCE)
abstract: In order to analyze the propagation characteristics of microwave relay equipment in Canyon terrain, "FEKO+WINPROP" software of 2018 edition was applied to find out the reasonable location of relay equipment. Firstly, FEKO software is used to calculate the actual antenna pattern, and then the antenna pattern is used as a parameter to calculate the effective coverage of microwave relay equipment in WINPROP software. Finally, the communication is achieved by choosing the reasonable position as the relay point in the effective coverage range. Taking a canyon area as an example, the radio wave is carried out in the area of a certain canyon. The location of relay equipment is obtained by the propagation prediction calculation in this area. The calculation results show that the method is accurate and practical.

articleTitle: Research of Manufacturing Process of Mixed Straw Particleboard by Minitab Software
publicationTitle: 2019 4th International Conference on Mechanical, Control and Computer Engineering (ICMCCE)
abstract: The process parameters of particleboard mixed corn straw and wood residue were studied in this paper. The effects of the mixing ratio of raw material, glue content, hot pressing temperature, hot pressing pressure on modulus of rupture, modulus of elasticity, internal bond strength, 2h water absorption thickness swelling of the mixed straw plate were analyzed by orthogonal test method. Within the scope of the experimental study, Minitab software was carried out data analysis. The process parameters of mixed straw board were optimized as follows: mixing ratio of raw material 4:6, glue content 12%, hot pressing temperature 135oC, hot pressing pressure 8Mpa. Mixed straw particleboard can meet GB/t4897-2015 standard of common particleboard.

articleTitle: Application of Electronic Laser Range Finder in Sports Achievement Measurement
publicationTitle: 2019 4th International Conference on Mechanical, Control and Computer Engineering (ICMCCE)
abstract: With the development of science and technology and information nowadays, sports are also developing in the direction of science and technology sports and green sports. At present, many sports include sports training and competitions. Mass fitness and school sports are evaluated by performance measurement, which puts forward higher requirements for the reliability and accuracy of sports performance measurement. Therefore, with the development of surveying and science and technology, the electronic laser measuring instrument is widely used in sports and various fields, which brings convenience to the measurement of sports performance. In this paper, the application of electronic laser measuring instrument in sports is studied by means of documentation, experimental comparison, mathematical statistics and field measurement.

articleTitle: The Method for Measuring Center Coordinates of the Out-of-Focus Spot
publicationTitle: 2019 4th International Conference on Mechanical, Control and Computer Engineering (ICMCCE)
abstract: Miniaturization of the device has become the key of precision measurement system and spot center detection plays a very important role in measuring rotation angle. For the imaging problem of the light source in the image sensor when measuring the rotation center coordinate, a method using the out-of-focus image of the spot to make the measuring device smaller was proposed. Firstly, we preprocess the out-of-focus image. Then the center coordinates of the spot are obtained by using the least square circle fitting method, with the light source rotates, we will obtain a series of center coordinates of the spot. Lastly, the least square circle fitting method is used to fit the center coordinates of the rotating spot to find the center coordinates of rotation axis. Experimental results show that the error between the ideal rotation center and the center obtained by this method can less than 0.7 pixel.

articleTitle: Analysis Method of Influencing Factors of Modern Tram Operation Energy Consumption
publicationTitle: 2019 4th International Conference on Mechanical, Control and Computer Engineering (ICMCCE)
abstract: In view of the traditional tram energy consumption analysis method be lack of judge and analysis of abnormal data as well as is difficult to effectively discover the characteristics of energy consumption data and the potential relationship between data, an integration method of tramcar energy consumption analysis with control charts and grey correlation analysis is proposed. By using the control chart, the fluctuation of energy consumption data is analyzed, and the influence degree of each factor on energy consumption data is analyzed by grey relational analysis. The simulation experiment is carried out by using the energy consumption data of Guangzhou tram cars. The result shows that the tram energy consumption analysis method proposed not only can analyze the characteristics of all energy consumption data and mine potential relations among data, but also can monitor the fluctuation of energy consumption data and identify the abnormal energy consumption data as well as related factors that affect energy consumption. providing auxiliary decision-making for energy saving of tram system, which can provide some reference for the analysis of the energy consumption data of the running tramcar.

articleTitle: Performance Research of Consider Transceiver Impairment Separately in Non-ideal Channels of Multi-user Multi-cell MIMO System
publicationTitle: 2019 4th International Conference on Mechanical, Control and Computer Engineering (ICMCCE)
abstract: For the downlink of multi-user and multi-cell wireless Multiple-Input Multiple-Output (MIMO) communication system, there are three cases in the case of channel imperfection: the transmitter considers impairment but the receiver is ideal, the receiver consid-ers impairment but the transmitter is ideal and the transceiver considers impairment. We propose the corresponding system performance optimization algorithm through beamforming de-sign, and the differences of the system performance under three conditions are compared without considering impairment. The simulation results show that the robustness of three cases are better than that without considering the impairment at the trans-ceiver in the probabilistic constrained channel.

articleTitle: An Image Classification Scheme for Improved Convolutional Neural Networks
publicationTitle: 2019 4th International Conference on Mechanical, Control and Computer Engineering (ICMCCE)
abstract: In order to solve the defects of low classification accuracy and slow convergence speed in the traditional image classification task, this paper designs an improved neural network based on particle swarm algorithm. The network improves the convolutional neural network by changing the method of bias value update during back propagation. The traditional method of changing the bias value is the gradient descent method, but there may be the problem of gradient disappearance and gradient exploding. In this paper, the particle swarm algorithm is used instead of the gradient descent method to solve the problem of gradient disappearance. It is analyzed by the test with handwritten data set. The convergence speed and accuracy of the method are also improved compared with the traditional convolutional neural network.

articleTitle: Design of Dynamic Parameter Testing System for Satellite Power
publicationTitle: 2019 4th International Conference on Mechanical, Control and Computer Engineering (ICMCCE)
abstract: When the satellite changes its working state, its power output will produce instantaneous jump. Accurate measurement of dynamic parameters of satellite power is the basis to ensure the normal operation of other modules. Aiming at the shortcomings of low automation level, low precision, poor data recording and analysis ability in dynamic parameter testing of satellite power system, a dynamic parameter testing system with high accuracy and automation level is designed, which integrates data acquisition, analysis and calculation, display and storage functions. Solar cell simulator and electronic load are used to simulate the output of solar panels and the power consumption change of loads when satellites are in orbit. With high-speed acquisition card, dynamic characteristic measurement unit is developed. Satellite power system and dynamic parameter measurement system are established and carried out. The test results show the reliability of the system.

articleTitle: Video Based Fire Detection in Photovoltaic System
publicationTitle: 2019 4th International Conference on Mechanical, Control and Computer Engineering (ICMCCE)
abstract: Video fire detection is of great significance in complex scene fire alarms, such as photovoltaic systems and factory workshops. The difficulty of flame detection is to overcome the effects of objects similar to flames and the interference of camera shake. In order to improve the accuracy of detection, image preprocessing is first carried out, then the motion foreground is extracted by ViBe algorithm, and then the RGB and HIS color features are used to perform threshold constraint. Finally, the flame region is detected from the motion region. The experimental results show that the algorithm is robust in complex scenarios and has good real-time performance.

articleTitle: Querying XML Data using Description Logics
publicationTitle: 2019 4th International Conference on Mechanical, Control and Computer Engineering (ICMCCE)
abstract: Recently, ontology-based data access is more and more employed in the context of data integration. That is, to the usual data layer of an information system we superimpose a conceptual layer to be exposed to the client. In this paper, we discuss a way to query XML data over conceptual layer using Description Logics. Given a XML data file, we first map the XML DTD to a corresponding relational schema preserving the original semantics of the XML DTD, and at the meantime, we store the XML data into the relational database. After that, we create an ontology described in Description Logics with respect to the relational schema. When a Description Logic query is posted to the ontology TBox, we map it to SQL query with respect to the relational database. In this way, we can query XML data using Description Logics. The main contribution of this thesis can be seen as the following two parts: 1. We proposed a mapping from XML DTD to relational schema with constraints preserving the original XML DTD semantics. 2. We described a framework of querying XML data using Description Logics, more precisely, the DL-LiteA logic.

articleTitle: Application of Narrow Band Internet of Things Technology in Coalbed Methane Well Production
publicationTitle: 2019 4th International Conference on Mechanical, Control and Computer Engineering (ICMCCE)
abstract: A low-power, low-cost and wide-coverage oil and gas production intelligent monitoring system based on NB-IoT is proposed. Currently, the monitoring data of the CBM wells is almost transmitted through the GPRS/GSM communication networks which cause high power consumption and high cost. With the introduction of the "Made in China 2025" plan, it become especially necessary to achieve a smooth upgrade of the existing industrial network. The overall idea of the design is to use the low-power STM32L431RCT6 as the MCU to collect the CBM well data, which this paper takes the liquid temperature, the hydraulic pressure and the liquid flow rate as examples, and sends the data to the NB-IoT module through the MCU. The NB-IoT module can utilize the existing telecom operators' NB base station to transmit data to the cloud server. Finally, the detection value is displayed to the user through the C# client program. The user can issue a command to the MCU in the well site through the client program to stop the work of the pumping unit when the monitoring data is abnormal. The result of experiment test indicates that the system has the characteristics of stable operation, high precision and safe information transmission.

articleTitle: Technical Research and Test Verification of Residual Strength of Defective White Copper Pipeline
publicationTitle: 2019 4th International Conference on Mechanical, Control and Computer Engineering (ICMCCE)
abstract: White copper material has strong corrosion resistance, more and more widely used in the warship's seawater pipeline system, however, the corrosion problem still cannot be ignored, because of the corrosive environment. Once the pipeline is corroded, the strength of that is decreased, then, under the action of internal and external pressure prone to rupture and cause safety accidents. In this paper, the residual strength of defective white copper pipelines is evaluated by DNV RP-F101 method and SY/T6477-2014 method, and the results of the evaluation are verified by using static water pressure experiment. The test results show that the prediction results using the DNV RP-F101 method are more accurate, and the SY/T6477-2014 method is relatively conservative. Considering the special requirements for reliability and safety of the warship's seawater pipelines, the prediction results of both methods are of great significance to the prediction of residual strength and the evaluation of maintenance decisions.

articleTitle: Collaborative Beamforming Technology for Multi-cell and Multi-user Interval Interference
publicationTitle: 2019 4th International Conference on Mechanical, Control and Computer Engineering (ICMCCE)
abstract: In order to improve the robustness of collaborative beamforming of multi-cell and multi-user channel error. We consider the multi-cell and multi-user interval interference based on non-ideal factors of transceiver impairment. Firstly, a coll-aborative beamforming algorithm for multi-cell and multi-user interferences is proposed in this paper, which is based on the collaborative method of shared channel information. Therefore, the co-channel interference is effectively suppressed by cooperative beamforming. Secondly, by the means of releasing the non-convex constraints step by step the original robust nonconvex optimization issues are transformed into relatively easy-to-solve equivalent issues. Futhermore, we solve the equivalent problem by using the second-order cone programming (SCOP) method. Finally, collaborative beamforming algorithm considering multi-cell and multi-user interval channel interference is compared with the ideal channel error algorithm. The numerical simulation results show that the proposed algorithm is better than existing protocols.

articleTitle: Yang's Substance Content Changing Law in Current Around Island
publicationTitle: 2019 4th International Conference on Mechanical, Control and Computer Engineering (ICMCCE)
abstract: Using investigation data on chromium (Cr) in surface and bottom waters in Jiaozhou Bay in April, July and October 1982, this paper analyzed the substance content's changing law in current around island. Results showed that during the rising tide, surface water was moving from the outer side of the island to the inner side of the island, while it was bottom waters was moving from the inner side of the island to the outer side of the island, resulting in a space cycle between surface waters and bottom waters. During the falling tide, both surface water and bottom water were moving from the inner side of the island to the outer side of the island. The rising tide and falling tide represented that Yang's substance content changing law in current around island: Along with the flow direction of marine tide, the locations in one side of the island and another side of the island could be considered as the starting point and end point, respectively. Substance contents in the starting point and end point showed the vertical disputed amount and vertical sediment amount, respectively.

articleTitle: MSR-Based Reading Strategy of SSD
publicationTitle: 2019 4th International Conference on Mechanical, Control and Computer Engineering (ICMCCE)
abstract: SSD (Solid State Drive) has become an important storage device recently, and it is widely used in various types of computer systems. This paper proposes a scheme that can optimize SSD read access based on MSR encoding. The main idea is that using the redundant data in the SSD to get read access acceleration when the SSD performs the read operations. We implement this scheme on the SSD emulator to verify the effectiveness of the scheme. The results show that the scheme has a significant improvement in reading large files.

articleTitle: Design of IoT Platform Based on Loongson Network Convergence
publicationTitle: 2019 4th International Conference on Mechanical, Control and Computer Engineering (ICMCCE)
abstract: Most of the current network equipment is based on the foreign software and hardware. The hardware uses a common ARM processor, lacking independent property rights, and there are security risks caused by the core technology. In view of the fact that the performance and reliability of the domestic Loongson processor cannot meet the requirements of the IoT network security equipment, this paper designs parallel processing technology architecture of the double Loongson processor, transplants the Neokylin operating system, and studies the IoT gateway of the general knowledge platform. It integrates various Internet of Things communication standards, spans the information barrier of the Internet of Things, and deeply studies the highly intelligent gateway technology of cloud platform data processing. Based on this architecture, a multi-functional security protection gateway is designed. The hardware is compatible with the ATCA standard. The system design adopts an open architecture and follows the principles of generalization, serialization and modular design, and at the same time reserves a trusted computing interface. While improving the level of autonomous control, it compensates for the lack of performance and reliability of domestic processors, and can meet the daily use requirements of the Internet of Things user network environment. The design of the test project was carried out according to the content of the Internet of Things. After testing, all parts of the platform can run normally and perform well.

articleTitle: Design and Test of Swing-Type Residual Film Picker Release Mechanism
publicationTitle: 2019 4th International Conference on Mechanical, Control and Computer Engineering (ICMCCE)
abstract: In order to solve the problem strapless in the de-filming mechanism in the process of de-release, tied in the picking of teeth on the residual film can not be taken into the film box and waste power and other problems, the design of the rotary residual film picker release mechanism. The theoretical analysis shows that the device is feasible in the recovery of residual film. The test results show that the release rate of rotary residual film picker release mechanism reaches 90.5%, which meets the requirements of the farmers for the release mechanism of the residual film picker, and provides a new way of thinking for the design of the residual film recycling machine release mechanism.

articleTitle: Research on Wireless Network System
publicationTitle: 2019 4th International Conference on Mechanical, Control and Computer Engineering (ICMCCE)
abstract: This paper mainly studies the wireless network system, and designs the wireless network system from the aspects of working frequency band, air interface, routing protocol and distributed numbering framework with smart phone. Finally, it analyses its functions.

articleTitle: Research on Failure Detection and Self-Balance Mechanism of Urban Rain Transit Vehicle Suspension System
publicationTitle: 2019 4th International Conference on Mechanical, Control and Computer Engineering (ICMCCE)
abstract: In this paper, by studying the domestic and international numerous documents on vehicle suspension system failure detection methodology, different kinds of method were introduced in detail, according to the characteristics of the Urban Rain Transit Vehicle Suspension System during working state, the feasibility and the advantages and disadvantages of vehicle suspension system failure detection methodologies were discussed. To realize in-situ measurement, a novel method of fault detection and self -balance based on four-port theory was proposed, which will also be the theoretical base for the future study on failure detection and control.

articleTitle: The Design of Treadmill with Distributed Generation Function
publicationTitle: 2019 4th International Conference on Mechanical, Control and Computer Engineering (ICMCCE)
abstract: Physical health is very important to economic development, and with the improvement of the living standard, indoor treadmills are more and more popular. However, traditional treadmill drive system has many drawbacks. In order to meet the requirements of low-carbon environmental protection, it is necessary to develop an electromagnetic damping control system capable of distributed generation to improve the shortcomings of traditional treadmill drive system. Therefore, we designed a treadmill that uses PWM mode to adjust the electromagnetic damping, which can guarantee the accuracy of damping adjustment during the movement process. This system integrated intelligent charging management and data networking function together, which can greatly enhance the practicability of the treadmill. If a large number of such treadmills are brought together and the electricity generated from the treadmills is so large that could be connected to the grid, which will effectively alleviate the energy shortage.

articleTitle: An Efficient Implementation of an Improved HLLC-Type Scheme to GPU-Accelerated Simulation of Hypersonic Thermochemical Nonequilibrium Flows
publicationTitle: 2019 4th International Conference on Mechanical, Control and Computer Engineering (ICMCCE)
abstract: The thermochemical nonequilibrium effect refers to the complicated physical and chemical processes of gas during hypersonic flights. The surrounding gas is heated to a very high temperature. The properties of gas change due to the high temperature, thus leading to the thermochemical nonequilibrium effect. The thermochemical nonequilibrium effect is critical for hypersonic aerodynamic design and optimization. Possibility of graphics processor units (GPUs) parallel computation technique for the simulation of hypersonic flows is also demonstrated. To cure the shock instability in the simulation of hypersonic thermochemical nonequilibrium flows, a shock-stable HLLC-type scheme is introduced. A ELECTRE cone test case is conducted in NVIDIA GTX Titan Black GPU to validate the accuracy and efficiency of this proposed GPU accelerated thermochemical nonequilibrium solver. Numerical result demonstrates that the simulation time is greatly shortened and the accuracy of hypersonic flows is improved.

articleTitle: Personalized College English Learning Based on Artificial Intelligence
publicationTitle: 2019 4th International Conference on Mechanical, Control and Computer Engineering (ICMCCE)
abstract: With the powerful learning ability and computing ability, artificial intelligence can push personalized learning resources for learners after a comprehensive analysis of the collected big data, making the adaptive learning coefficient close to 1, for which learners can complete learning tasks in a more pleasant state and make more progress in study; AI-supported Multi-dimensional diagnostic evaluation and resource feedback of test proved to strengthen students' language cognition ability and promote the development of English learning.

articleTitle: Optimal Setting of pH Values During Iron Removal by Goethite Precipitation
publicationTitle: 2019 4th International Conference on Mechanical, Control and Computer Engineering (ICMCCE)
abstract: Zinc hydrometallurgy is the main process for zinc smelting, while iron removal by goethite precipitation is the key process. A reasonable pH value of the solution is an important condition to generate goethite. Through analysis of production data and the characteristics of parameters of inlet conditions, this study proposed an optimal setting method for pH values with cascade reactors based on division of working conditions and expert rules. The results of industrial verification show the effectiveness of the proposed method.

articleTitle: Research on Cross-Layer Routing Algorithm Based on Congestion Prediction
publicationTitle: 2019 4th International Conference on Mechanical, Control and Computer Engineering (ICMCCE)
abstract: Wireless ad hoc network (MANET) is a kind of network that can communicate without infrastructure. It has the characteristics of dynamic topology, limited bandwidth and constrainted terminal energy, and so on. These characteristics make the MANET impose many specific and strict requirements on routing protocols. In order to solve the problem of high packet loss rate and network congestion, a cross-layer routing algorithm based on congestion prediction (CLRACP) is proposed. In this algorithm, a congestion prediction mechanism is proposed, which makes high-load nodes do not need to forward routing request messages and effectively avoids high-load nodes being selected as forwarding nodes. A cross-layer routing algorithm is also proposed, which combines underlying link quality information to choose and select routing to improve the routing timeliness.

articleTitle: Formation and Migration of Hot Water Mass in the Waterbody of Jiaozhou Bay
publicationTitle: 2019 4th International Conference on Mechanical, Control and Computer Engineering (ICMCCE)
abstract: Based on the survey on the waterbody of Jiaozhou Bay in May, June, July, August, September and October of 1980, the authors studied the horizontal distribution of surface layer and regional variation of temperature of the waterbody of Jiaozhou Bay. The results show that the water temperature of Jiaozhou Bay in May, June, July, August, September and October range from 10.80 to 26.53 degrees, and the temperature in August rose to the peak. From May to August, the temperature variation generally showed a rising trend. From May to June, the high temperature zone moved from the northern coastal area to the western part of the inner bay mouth. From July to August, the high temperature zone migrated from the northern coastal water to the western area inside the Bay mouth. From September and October, the temperature variation generally showed a declining trend and the high temperature zones gathered in the water outside the Bay mouth. Yang Dongfang put forward the concept "hot water mass", which is defined as the waterbody of an area hotter than the surrounding area inside a waterbody, also known as "Yang Dongfang hot water mass". In May, the atmosphere and the sun transported heat to the surface of Jiaozhou Bay, and a hot water mass formed in and around the northern coastal water. By June, tidal and current movements brought the hot water mass to the deep water area in the west of the Bay mouth. In July, a hot water mass formed in the northern coastal water. By August, the hot water mass migrated to the western water inside the Bay mouth. From September to October, the high temperature zone is located in the outer water of Jiaozhou Bay, and there is no hot water mass.

articleTitle: Analysis of Application and Development Trend of Computer Software in the New Era
publicationTitle: 2019 4th International Conference on Mechanical, Control and Computer Engineering (ICMCCE)
abstract: In this information age, software and apps that rely on the Internet and computer technology are becoming more and more diversified, boosting fast development of computer software, and the computer software industry is enjoying a grand prospect for further development. Compared with hardware, computer software is more in number, has stronger functions, and updates more quickly. Because of these advantages, it enjoys wide application in social life and presents a trend of integration with the Internet, intelligentization and servitization, providing vital support for transformation of different sectors in the new era. This paper analyzes the status quo of application of computer software development, explores problems within, and proposes some ideas about application and development trend of computer software development in hopes of providing references.

articleTitle: Research on Intelligent Flaps of Wind Turbine Blades
publicationTitle: 2019 4th International Conference on Mechanical, Control and Computer Engineering (ICMCCE)
abstract: This paper mainly studies the piezoelectric driving amplifier for the trailing edge flaps of wind turbine blades. Firstly, two kinds of structure models of piezoelectric amplifier are built by using three-dimensional software, and then ANSYS analysis software is imported. Then, the analysis module is built on the working platform. Secondly, material parameters are input and meshing is done. In order to ensure the quality, we choose high-order quadrilateral element to refine the local mesh in order to improve the accuracy. At the same time, restrictions and pressures should be imposed. Finally, the simulation results are analyzed, and the diamond amplifier is selected as the comparison analysis result, which provides a reference for the application of piezoelectric driving mechanism in intelligent wind turbine blades.

articleTitle: Research on New Energy Vehicle Safety Assessment Based on AHP
publicationTitle: 2019 4th International Conference on Mechanical, Control and Computer Engineering (ICMCCE)
abstract: With the increasing number of new energy vehicles, the occurrence of new energy vehicle safety accidents is also increasing, and the safety of new energy vehicles has received widespread attention from the government, scholars and society. How to construct a scientific assessment of new energy vehicle safety assessment system and analyze the main factors affecting the safety of new energy vehicles is the focus of this paper. In this paper, a multi-index evaluation matrix is established based on the Analytic Hierarchy Process (AHP), and it is calculated by the numerical analysis software MATLAB. According to the calculation results, the main influencing factors affecting the safety of new energy vehicles are obtained.

articleTitle: Brain Activity Recognition of Chinese Character Processing Based on Functional Magnetic Resonance Image
publicationTitle: 2019 4th International Conference on Mechanical, Control and Computer Engineering (ICMCCE)
abstract: Brain activity recognition based on functional magnetic resonance image (fMRI) as a vital problem in computer vision has been applied to many fields. Chinese character processing is one of the most remarkable applications of brain activity recognition at present, it has shown great performance using activation data and cognitive experiment in different brain regions. Inspired by new machine learning methods, this paper proposes an extraction method of human brain data with region of interest (ROI) and a activity recognition method of classifying Chinese character processing with support vector machine (SVM) and random forest (RF). By comparison, the SVM approach and RF approach achieve the average correct classification rate of Left Inferior Frontal Gyrus (LIFG) region of human brain with 74.1% and 80.5% after the ROI extraction, respectively. The experiments indicate that the brain's processing mechanism does differ when facing the Chinese characters of different structures, the LIFG brain region plays an important role in this process, and the RF approach would achieve better performance than SVM in term of average correct classification rate.

articleTitle: Research on Lightweight Design of a Machine Tool Component Based on Unit Mass Stiffness
publicationTitle: 2019 4th International Conference on Mechanical, Control and Computer Engineering (ICMCCE)
abstract: In the design process of machine tool structure, the weight of machine tool can be lightened by optimizing the thickness and shape of the body. Bending stiffness, tensional stiffness, first-order bending mode, and first order tensional modal, are all important index of machine tool bed performances. These are usually the optimal goals of early designs. Nevertheless, these performances cannot qualify the influences on lightweight. Through the organic combination of these performance indicators and quality, it is easy to put forward unit mass of stiffness (machine components unit stiffness) which considers every performance of the machine tool bed on the quality concept, so as to be used for light-weighting machine tool quality level of lightweight. These unit mass stiffness as the target value, the important parts of the screening analysis, through the quantification of the impact of each variable on lightweight, select conducive to lightweight variables, lightweight machine tools for multi-objective optimization.

articleTitle: Diagnosis and Analysis of Network Communication Faults in Electricity
publicationTitle: 2019 4th International Conference on Mechanical, Control and Computer Engineering (ICMCCE)
abstract: With the application of network communication technology in AMI solution is increasing, the complexity of power communication network also increases. In the actual operation process, it is easy to be affected by various factors to break down, which will lead to the interruption of power grid communication and delay the timely handling of accidents, which will affect the normal production of industrial and commercial users, and even cause a large number of blackouts, even more serious. Causing the collapse of power grid communications, the consequences are unimaginable. Firstly, this paper introduces the architecture of power AMI communication network, then makes a detailed study of the faults and their causes in the operation of power AMI communication network. Finally, it introduces the system evaluation and analysis methods of the faults. The practical effect of the study shows that the method in this paper can help operators locate the faults quickly and improve the operation and maintenance efficiency.

articleTitle: Exploring the Application of BIM Engineering in Multi-project Main Body Collaborative Management Platform
publicationTitle: 2019 4th International Conference on Mechanical, Control and Computer Engineering (ICMCCE)
abstract: As the domestic economy continues to grow steadily, the number and scale of construction projects continue to increase. Construction projects involve a lot of content and require close coordination between multiple departments. During the construction of the construction project, there is a lot of information transmission in every part of the construction. However, due to various objective factors, information distortion often occurs. Not only will it lead to inefficient work, but it will also leave a lot of security risks. The collaborative engineering project coordination mechanism needs to analyze the actual needs and actively create a collaborative management model with BIM technology as the core. This paper mainly discusses the BIM engineering application management ideas of the multi-project main body collaborative management platform, and puts forward opinions and suggestions based on the actual situation.

articleTitle: Clutter Reduced-Dimension Sparse Recovery Method on Knowledge-Aided for Airborne Phased Array Radar
publicationTitle: 2019 4th International Conference on Mechanical, Control and Computer Engineering (ICMCCE)
abstract: To reduce the computational load of the typical sparse recovery space-time adaptive processing (SR-STAP), a novel reduced-dimension SR method on knowledge-aided is proposed. According to the clutter distribution in the spatial-temporal plane, partial grid points near the clutter bridge are first selected to form a subset as prior knowledge. Then, clutter data on each grid point from SR dictionary are denoted and correlated coefficients between the grid data from the prior subset and that from the SR dictionary are defined. Lastly, the threshold about SR reduced-dimension is designed and the reduced-dimension dictionary is constructed. Monte Carlo simulation results show the proposed method reduces the computational burden significantly and has the highly similar clutter suppression performance with the typical SR-STAP.

articleTitle: Research on Multi-sub-Graph Parallel Analysis Method for Power Grid Graph Data
publicationTitle: 2019 4th International Conference on Mechanical, Control and Computer Engineering (ICMCCE)
abstract: In recent years, with the expansion of power grid scale and in-depth information construction, the data generated by the operation of power grid information system has increased rapidly, and the power big data environment has gradually formed. The power grid graph data has gradually become an important data storage and analysis solution due to its good support for power grid topology analysis, which is used as the basis for analysis of power grid business systems. In this paper, a multi-sub-graph parallel analysis method based on region partitioning is proposed. Firstly, the power grid graph data is divided into multiple sub-graphs based on region attributes, and then a parallel analysis algorithm for multiple sub-graphs is proposed. Related experiments show that the parallel analysis scheme of power grid graph data is effective and can meet the actual needs of power grid graph.

articleTitle: Design of a Stroboscopic Laser Grating Stripe Projection Device
publicationTitle: 2019 4th International Conference on Mechanical, Control and Computer Engineering (ICMCCE)
abstract: A three-dimensional measuring system based on a line-structured laser and a high-speed rotating multi-faced prism has been designed and described in detail. The grating fringe can be produced using stroboscopic effect in the system. The relationship between grating stripe and modulation signal and prism rotation speed are analyzed from both theoretical and experimental aspects. At the same time, the grating stripe projection device is applied to the three-dimensional measurement of gypsum section.

articleTitle: High Resolution Image Classification of Urban Areas Based on Convolution Neural Network
publicationTitle: 2019 4th International Conference on Mechanical, Control and Computer Engineering (ICMCCE)
abstract: In the process of urbanization, land is gradually reduced, and artificial targets(concrete, asphalt, stone paving, et al.) are increased. Remote sensing technology is one of the main means to analyze and obtain data of urban spatial pattern. The classification method and accuracy of remote sensing image directly affect the accuracy of information extraction. In this paper, a method of deep learning - convolutional neural network is used to classify in urban areas high-resolution remote sensing images. Firstly, the basic principle of CNN method are introduced, and parameters suitable for this image classification are selected. In this study, the model structure of CNN is set to four layers, and more abstract expression features are obtained from bottom layer to top layer, and compared with traditional classification methods. Classification accuracy of CNNs is 85.3%, Indistinguishable the artificial surface features in urban areas have very good classification results using CNNs.

articleTitle: Application of Control Parameter Adjustment Algorithm in Electrical Automation Professionalism
publicationTitle: 2019 4th International Conference on Mechanical, Control and Computer Engineering (ICMCCE)
abstract: In view of the strict performance requirements of modern control, the automation profession attaches more and more importance to parameter adjustment algorithm of the control system. In the process of parameter adjustment, not only the whole steps should be clearly defined, but also the precautions should be paid attention to. It is advisable to analyze the relationships between various systems and make adjustments to achieve harmony. Therefore, this thesis focuses on the relevant key points of parameter adjustment in automation professionalism.

articleTitle: Research on Development and Design of Virtual Acupuncture Teaching Software Based on HTC VIVE
publicationTitle: 2019 4th International Conference on Mechanical, Control and Computer Engineering (ICMCCE)
