abstract: With the continuous development of computer technology, virtual reality technology has been applied more and more in traditional teaching. In order to improve the students' interest in learning Chinese acupuncture, this paper studies the key technologies in the development of virtual acupuncture teaching software based on virtual reality technology. Model the human body is modeled and pays attention to the contour drawing of the key parts of the human body. The software combines with the current most popular virtual reality device HTC VIVE and uses the Unity3d software to create virtual scenes. Finally, acupoint information models are represented and stored through JavaScript Object Notation (JSON) language, which completes the design of human-computer interaction mode. The implementation of virtual reality technology provides a new method and reference solution for assisting Chinese acupuncture teaching.

articleTitle: Reliability Analysis of Embryonic Electronic Array in Cold Standby
publicationTitle: 2019 4th International Conference on Mechanical, Control and Computer Engineering (ICMCCE)
abstract: Existing reliability model of embryonic electronic array (EA) is not suitable for EA in cold standby. The model of series system with cold standby parts (SSC) is proposed. According to the memoryless property of exponential distribution and the additivity of gamma distribution, reliability models of SSC is deduced. Experiments are conducted on 4 random EAs. Three methods are chosen to be compared, such as Monte-Carlo method, k out of n, SSC. Experimental results show that SSC can measure the reliability for cold standby, similar to that of Monte-Carlo. But k out of n can't efficiently measure the reliability for cold standby. In addition, The SSC and k out of n exactly measures the reliability varied in layout of working cell, which can be further used to optimize the array design.

Author Keywords: series system with cold standby parts

articleTitle: Research on the Relation between Artificial Intelligence and Mechanical and Electronic Engineering
publicationTitle: 2019 4th International Conference on Mechanical, Control and Computer Engineering (ICMCCE)
abstract: With the improvement of social economy and the development of science and technology, mechanical and electronic information engineering plays an important role in people's daily life. At the same time, the rapid development of modern mechanical and electronic engineering has greatly improved the level of productivity and made mechanical and electronic engineering more intelligent. The development of artificial intelligence technology is a very important part of it, and it is also a manifestation of better innovation and progress in mechanical and electronic engineering. In this paper, the characteristics of Mechatronics Engineering and artificial intelligence are expounded, the relationship between them is analyzed, and the application of artificial intelligence in mechatronics engineering is studied.

articleTitle: SG Petrochemical Equipment Enterprise Facilities Planning and Logistics Analysis and Research
publicationTitle: 2019 4th International Conference on Mechanical, Control and Computer Engineering (ICMCCE)
abstract: Taking the workshop of SG petrochemical equipment enterprise as the research object, this paper analyzes the production status of workshop and analyzes the logistics of workshop by measuring the moving volume of workshop materials and the distance between workshop processes. The paper finds out the existing problems in the machining workshop and puts forward the improvement measures. The SLP method is used to analyze the layout of the workshop facilities, and comprehensively improves the production efficiency of the entire workshop.

articleTitle: Structure Design of NC Adjustable Universal Side Milling Head
publicationTitle: 2019 4th International Conference on Mechanical, Control and Computer Engineering (ICMCCE)
abstract: Universal side milling head is an important accessory of NC milling machine in machining center. Its structure and performance largely determine the performance of the whole machine tool. At present, the angle adjustment range of universal milling head is small and the center of gravity is not on the main axis of the machine tool, which seriously affects the milling accuracy. Through investigation and scheme analysis, a NC universal side milling head which is adjustable in the range 0~120 degree is designed. The structure is driven by bevel gear and spur gear, and connected with the spindle by BT40 tool shank and pull rod. Its C-axis is indexed by clutch and rat tooth disc. A-axis is indexed by forward and reverse rotation of high-torque magnetic servo motor and deceleration drive of worm wheel and worm. The requirement of universal NC machining can be achieved, which will provide some reference for the research of universal milling head.

articleTitle: Evaluation of Distributed Photovoltaic Consumption Capacity of Distribution Network Based on Cuckoo Search Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2019 4th International Conference on Mechanical, Control and Computer Engineering (ICMCCE)
abstract: Accessing distributed photovoltaic (PV) in distribution network will bring many adverse effects. It is very important to study the consumption capacity of distributed PV in distribution network for maintaining the safe operation of distribution network. In this paper, the impact of distributed PV power access on power quality, short-circuit capacity and network loss of distribution network is studied by establishing an optimization model aiming at maximizing the net benefit of photovoltaic accessed. A cuckoo algorithm for solving the problem of PV consumption is proposed. In the actual distribution network model, the economic benefits of PV accessed are analyzed from the aspects of power factor, load level and PV investment coefficient, respectively. The availability of the consumption capacity analysis method proposed in this paper is verified.

articleTitle: DOA Estimation Algorithm for Dual-Target Narrowband Coherent Sources
publicationTitle: 2019 4th International Conference on Mechanical, Control and Computer Engineering (ICMCCE)
abstract: Aiming at the feature of the narrowband signal received by linear array, an algorithm of the dual-target coherent sources DOA estimation is proposed in this paper. The algorithm can calculate the DOA of a single target or double targets directly by estimating space frequency of target signals. The principle of the algorithm is provided and simulated with programmed signal in this paper, and the factors of influencing DOA estimation are also analyzed in this paper. The simulation result shows that the algorithm has high estimation accuracy, regardless of signal length, the algorithm is convenient for real-time processing, and has a good application prospect.

articleTitle: Research on Position Reversal Solution Model of 6-UPU Parallel Electric Platform
publicationTitle: 2019 4th International Conference on Mechanical, Control and Computer Engineering (ICMCCE)
abstract: According to the structural characteristics of 6-UPU parallel electric platform, the research on position reversal solution model is proposed without neglecting the factors of themselves rotation of electric cylinder and ball screw. In this paper, the position reversal solution model is established by using the method of vector analysis. According to the displacement performance index value of the parallel electric platform in the actual engineering project, the whole domain motion of the various degrees of freedom is analyzed. It is concluded that the maximum displacement of the electric cylinder is 0.9913m and occurs in the working condition of the longitudinal motion. This result provides a theoretical basis for the stroke selection of the electric cylinder and has the important value of engineering application.

articleTitle: Analysis of Relationship between Inlet Angle of Centrifugal Impeller Blades and Compressor Performance
publicationTitle: 2019 4th International Conference on Mechanical, Control and Computer Engineering (ICMCCE)
abstract: In order to study the influence of the change of the inlet angle of the centrifugal impeller on the performance of the centrifugal compressor, eight sets of centrifugal impellers with increasing inlet angle were designed by using the centrifugal impeller design software, and the flow field of different inlet angle blades was simulated by CFX computer simulation software. The simulation results show that the inlet angle of the centrifugal impeller has a significant influence on the performance of the centrifugal compressor. The total pressure ratio of the compressor decreases with the increase of the inlet angle of the blade. When the inlet angle of the blade is 40°, the total pressure ratio of the centrifugal compressor the maximum value is 4.6870. This simulation analysis provides a data reference for the design of high pressure ratio centrifugal compressors.

articleTitle: Analysis and Research on Failure Mechanism of Electrical Connector Burning Failure Mode
publicationTitle: 2019 4th International Conference on Mechanical, Control and Computer Engineering (ICMCCE)
abstract: There are many failures in the use of electrical connectors, such as increased contact resistance, intermittent open circuit, reduced insulation resistance, electrical burnout, etc. The most common failure manifestation is burnout. In order to help the manufacturers improve the quality level and the inherent reliability of the electrical connector; and assist the users reasonable applicate the electrical connector, so can improve the application reliability of the electrical connector, thereby reducing the risk of burnout in use, it is necessary to recognize the possible failure mechanism and root cause of the electrical connector burnout. The author analyzed the rules of many failure cases for electrical connector burnout, summarized these cases, and analyzes the possible mechanisms and root causes of burnout failure modes of electrical connectors. Finally, a large number of cases supported the analysis of this article, which can be used as a reference for engineers and technicians engaged in failure analysis and product improvement. The failure mechanisms and related causes of electrical connector burnout are quite complicated, such as poor crimping, excessive impedance of the contact point, insufficient dielectric strength of the insulating plastic, surface contamination of the insulating plastic, excessive carrying current, and excessive use temperature.

articleTitle: Design and Implementation of Audio Signal Acquisition System Based on FPGA
publicationTitle: 2019 4th International Conference on Mechanical, Control and Computer Engineering (ICMCCE)
abstract: In this paper, an audio signal acquisition system is designed and implemented based on the advantages of FPGA: programmable, low power consumption, strong parallel processing capacity, etc. The front-end conditioning module, amplification module, A/D conversion module, real-time data storage and preprocessing module are introduced in detail. Finally, the Modelsim is used for simulation to verify its effectiveness.

articleTitle: Average Capacity Analysis and Power Splitting with Direct Link Based Relaying Protocol for Wireless Information and Power Transfer Networks
publicationTitle: 2019 4th International Conference on Mechanical, Control and Computer Engineering (ICMCCE)
abstract: This paper investigates the power splitting based relaying protocol for simultaneous wireless information and power transfer (SWIPT) in a three-node communication network with a direct connection path. The energy harvesting of the relay node depends on source transmissions. The performance of the average capacity of the proposed model is studied. The capacity expression of the destination of the power splitting-based relaying (PSR) protocol of the direct link is obtained. We find the average capacity of the system maximization depends on system para-meters. An amplify-and-forward relay is used in researching the average capacity performance of the PSR protocol. We verify all the analysis results by numerical simulation, and prove that the proposed PSR protocol with direct link is better than the existing power splitting protocol non-direct link.

articleTitle: A Real-Time Acquisition and Analysis System of BDS Original Data Based on Double Core Microprocessor
publicationTitle: 2019 4th International Conference on Mechanical, Control and Computer Engineering (ICMCCE)
abstract: In view of the large amount of original data output by BeiDou satellite navigation receiver, a real-time acquisition and analysis system of satellite data based on double core microprocessor is designed with satellite navigation receiver UB482 and OMAP-L138 Processor in this paper. Data acquisition and data analysis are realized with the ARM core and the DSP core in OMAP-L138 Processor respectively. Starting program and application program of the double core are written. The experimental results show that the system can output analysis results including position and speed of the carrier, information of the visible satellite and so on at 1Hz frequency. On this basis, the BDS/SINS tightly-coupled integrated navigation system can be further realized.
